column1: 说实话，指挥官，我很意外你居然没有像我一样对这番局面感到既沮丧又筋疲力尽；毕竟，可以说整场闹剧从头到尾都得靠你亲自上阵奔走。为了一劳永逸地杜绝后患，我决定直接把重炮摆上台面。我有一艘军用降落舰 Fujin 已在轨道待命，而你要为它提供目标信息。Nephrite 正待在一座加固掩体中，此刻正在与 Davion 和 Steiner 两方的代表会面。我追他们追腻了。不如直接把他们都轰平。ZH
column2: 我真的很想知道，这种情况不会像我一样让你沮丧和消耗，指挥官.毕竟，在整场闹剧中，你必须做腿部工作.我已经决定，绕过所有潜在问题，引入真正意义上的重型枪支. Fujin，一艘军用空投艇，处于待命状态，您将接管目标获取. Nephrite 在一个加固的掩体中，目前正在与戴维恩和施泰纳家族的代表会面.我不想再去打猎软玉了.相反，我建议彻底销毁.

column1: 随着赫尔姆核心失传技术的重新引入，陶里安防卫军发现自己在邻国面前落后了。正如战锤时代那样，陶里安人转向了本土的塔洛斯。凭借易于维护、易于制造的名声，这一设计正是 TDF 所需。由于缺乏资源把重新设计的塔洛斯变成可行的量产型号，陶里安人向邻国求助，以换取加入正在进行的"三一联盟"谈判。在卡佩兰工程师的专业知识与卡诺普斯法域的财政投资帮助下，范登堡于 3059 年底在其新范登堡工厂开始限量制造塔洛斯。3062 年"三一联盟"正式签署，把生产许可授予 Majesty Metals 与 Detroit Consolidated Mech Works。两家公司迅速开设了自己的生产线，为自身使用并向外更远处出口而生产多种塔洛斯变体。Base
column2: 随着赫尔姆核心失落科技的重现，陶里安防卫军发现自己落后于邻国。正如战争时代一样，陶里安人转向了本土成长的塔洛斯。这款机甲以易于维护和易于制造著称，正是陶里安防卫军所需。由于缺乏资源将新设计的塔洛斯转为可行的量产型号，陶里安人以加入正在进行的“三位一体同盟“谈判为交换，寻求邻国援助。在卡佩兰工程师的专业知识与卡诺普斯女权国的资金投入协助下，范登堡于 3059 年末在其新范登堡工厂开始了塔洛斯的限量生产。3062 年三位一体同盟正式签署，授予陛下金属公司与底特律联合机工厂生产许可。两家公司迅速开设了自己的生产线，为自用与远销生产了塔洛斯的多种变体。

column1: 这是天琴联盟的凯撒·施泰纳将军的座机，他是 Furilo 公爵，也是边疆伯爵 Iris Steiner 之子。该机甲的正式编号为 AS7-CS，但大多数人称之为“Dämmerung（黄昏）”。凭借先进的XL引擎，它搭载了庞大的武器阵列。利用节省下来的重量，曾位于前臂的中型激光被替换为大型脉冲激光，悬挂安装在前臂下方。鉴于高斯步枪被视为大口径弹道武器的下一步演进，大公要求以一门弹药充足的高斯步枪取代 Atlas 的 AC/20。SRM弹药仓被完全拆除，LRM弹药仓也缩小，以便沿机甲中线安装一门ER大型激光，而髋部安装的中型激光则使武器库更为完整。如此广泛的武器配置，使该设计在任何距离上都能发挥其大部分武器的威力\\n\\n特性：战斗铁拳\\n\\n投放费用倍率：1.2
column2: 里兰联盟的凯撒·施泰纳将军——富里洛公爵、边区侯爵艾瑞斯·施泰纳之子——的专属机甲。该机甲名义上编号为 AS7-CS，但大多数人称之为“黎明”(Dämmerung)。得益于先进的 XL 引擎，它装备了极其庞大的武器群。利用节省出的重量，原本置于前臂的中型激光被替换为吊挂在前臂下方的大型脉冲激光。由于认为高斯步枪是重型口径弹道武器的下一步演进，大公要求以一门弹药充足的高斯步枪取代阿特拉斯的 AC/20。SRM 弹仓被完全拆除，LRM 弹仓则被缩小，以便沿机甲中线安装一门 ER 大型激光，髋部安装的中型激光则补全了整个武器库。这种广泛的武器分布使该设计能在任何距离上发挥其大部分火力。\\n\\n特性：战斗拳套\\n\\n投放成本倍率：1.2

column1: A Bondsman was a prisoner taken during combat by a Clan, of any caste or rank, who was held as an indentured servant. Bondsmen were bound by tradition, rather than chains, to work dutifully for their new masters. For a bondsman to purposefully neglect their responsibilities or even attempt escape stained not just their personal honor but the honor of their original Clan. Typically, a bondsman would either be released from their bond and sent back home, with little honor lost, or after a given period of time, be adopted and become a free, full member of their new Clan. When and whether an individual was released from their servitude varied between Clans and individuals: some only spent a token amount of time before being freed from their bondscord, while others would live out the rest of their lives as bondsmen.
column2: 俘虏是指在战斗中氏族捕获的囚犯，不论其种姓或军衔如何，都会被当作契约仆役关押. 俘虏受传统约束，而非锁链，必须为他们的新主人勤勉工作. 如果俘虏故意玩忽职守甚至试图逃跑，不仅会玷污其个人荣誉，也会玷污其原属氏族的荣誉. 通常，俘虏要么被解除束缚送回故乡，荣誉损失甚微; 要么在特定时期后被接纳，成为新氏族的自由正式成员. 个人何时以及是否被解除劳役，因氏族和个体而异: 有些人只度过象征性的短暂时间便被释放，而另一些人则会终其一生作为俘虏.

Typically, a bondswoman would either be released from their bond and sent back home, with little honor lost, or after a given period of time, be adopted and become a free, full member of their new Clan. When and whether an individual was released from their servitude varied between Clans and individuals: some only spent a token amount of time before being freed from their bondscord, while others would live out the rest of their lives as bondswomen.
column2: 俘虏是指在战斗中氏族捕获的囚犯，不论其种姓或军衔如何，都会被当作契约仆役关押. 俘虏受传统约束，而非锁链，必须为他们的新主人勤勉工作. 如果俘虏故意玩忽职守甚至试图逃跑，不仅会玷污其个人荣誉，也会玷污其原属氏族的荣誉. 通常，俘虏要么被解除束缚送回故乡，荣誉损失甚微; 要么在特定时期后被接纳，成为新氏族的自由正式成员. 个人何时以及是否被解除劳役，因氏族和个体而异: 有些人只度过象征性的短暂时间便被释放，而另一些人则会终其一生作为俘虏.

column1: A distant, abandoned, cousin of the Particle Projector Cannon, Tesla weapons use an ionizing beam to provide a conduit for an immensely powerful electric charge to strike the target. Tesla weapons deal little physical damage but play havoc with sensors and can have devastating effects on internal components.
column2: 【Tesla Rifle】作为粒子投射加农炮的一种久远且废弃的衍生技术  特斯拉武器使用电离束为极其强大的电荷提供导体  将其释放至目标. 特斯拉武器造成的物理伤害较低  但会严重干扰传感器  并可能对内部组件造成毁灭性影响.

column1: A Emergency Coolant System developed by Clan Jade Falcon as a reaction towards Dezgra use of Heat Weapons. VOLATILE!.
column2: 这是玉鹰氏族针对敌人使用高热武器这一不荣誉行为而研发的紧急冷却系统. 易爆!

column1: A favorite amongst bold light mech pilots, the Light Cockpit compresses life support systems and advanced piloting controls into a smaller space and drastically drops the overall weight but at the cost of an ejection system.
column2: 【Light Cockpit (M)】轻型驾驶舱深受大胆的轻型机甲机师喜爱，它将生命维持系统和先进的驾驶控制装置压缩到更小的空间内，并大幅降低了整体重量，但代价是没有弹射系统.

column1: A further adaptation of the Hardened Ferro-Fibrous armor by RISC, manage to increase the armor thickness even further at just a small increase in weight by using a special alloy of Ferro-Fibrous material and a extremely rare metal known has Wavehandium. However, due to the extensive space needs only superheavy 'Mechs can mount it and the exotic material can release energy outwards vigorously during a rapid expansion in volume upon heavy damage.
column2: 【Superheavy Ferro-Alloy】这是RISC对硬化铁纤维装甲的进一步改进版本，采用铁纤维材料与一种名为Wavehandium的极稀有金属制成的特殊合金，仅增加少量重量便进一步提升了装甲厚度. 然而，由于占用空间极大，只有超重型机甲才能安装. 此外，这种奇异材料在遭受重创时会迅速膨胀，并向外猛烈释放能量.

column1: All '机甲s come equipped with a stock cockpit configuration, which can be upgraded for improved performance. The Heavy Cockpit is a common standard amongst Minnesota Tribe Battle机甲s; for most, the extra weight is worth it to have the added fire control gear and pilot in what is effectively an 装甲ed Ferro-Fibrous bathtub.
column2: 【Heavy Cockpit (M)】所有机甲都配备标准驾驶舱配置，可升级以提升性能. 重型驾驶舱是明尼苏达部落战斗机甲的常见标准配置; 对大多数人来说，额外的重量是值得的，因为可以获得附加的火控设备，并且机师实际上置身于一个装甲化的铁纤维浴缸中.

column1: An actual outgrowth from the Lower Arms of this Leviathan that formed into lethal shredding claws capable of tearing anything apart.
column2: 【Reaper Claws】这头利维坦前臂上真正的增生组织  形成了致命的撕裂利爪  能够将任何东西撕碎.

column1: An attempt to bring on-board guidance systems back to MRM munitions, Hunter-Killer missiles sacrifice yield and range for powerful fire-and-forget systems on each warhead that build upon targeting data provided from the 机甲-board Artemis IV FCS.  Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an 弹药 Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
column2: 【Ammo MRM Hunter-Killer (C)】猎杀者导弹试图为MRM弹药重新引入机载制导系统  每枚弹头都配备了强大的发射后不管制导系统  并利用机甲搭载的阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统提供的目标数据  以牺牲弹头威力和射程为代价换取更高的命中能力. 弹药箱受到暴击时  箱内剩余弹药会发生爆炸  对安装部位造成伤害. 使用C.A.S.E.可降低此风险.

column1: An improvement upon Star League M.A.S.C. technology, Enhanced M.A.S.C. accelerates nearly all of the myomers within a Battle机甲. While this increases speed and melee power, actuators were not built for this kind of stress, and prolonged usage of EMASC systems can damage the actuators of a Battle机甲. Although this is unlikely to incapacitate the Battle机甲 outright, the danger of destroyed actuators is enough for cautious warriors to limit their use in battle. Activatable: DEALS DAMAGE AND CRIT TO LIMBS ON FAILURE
column2: 作为星盟M.A.S.C.技术的改进型，增强型M.A.S.C.能加速战斗机甲内几乎所有的人工肌纤维. 虽然这能提升速度和近战威力，但驱动器并非为承受这种压力而设计，长时间使用EMASC系统可能会损坏战斗机甲的驱动器. 尽管这不太可能直接导致战斗机甲丧失行动能力，但驱动器被毁的危险足以让谨慎的战士在战斗中限制其使用.可激活: 故障时对肢体造成伤害和暴击

column1: An otherwise unremarkable planet on the spinward edge of the Combine, Brihuega has become known as "The planet of spies" due to its "use" as a training ground for Commonwealth agents operating out of Farstar.
column2: 作为联合体顺旋边缘一颗原本毫不起眼的行星，Brihuega因其被“用作”以Farstar为基地活动的共同体特工的训练场，而被称为“间谍行星”.

column1: An unremarkable, self-sufficient planet only notable because the Capellan's seem to have an interest in it.  Aucara seems to have an unusual amount of "alleged" Maskirovka agents captured on it - which the Capellans deny.
column2: 一颗平平无奇、自给自足的行星，唯一值得注意的是卡佩拉人似乎对它感兴趣. Aucara上似乎有异常多的“据称”马斯基罗夫卡特工被抓——卡佩拉人对此予以否认.

column1: Another "Breadbasket" world deep in Lyran territory, Brooloo is a laid back world of large farms untouched by conflict.
column2: 另一个深处于天琴领地中的“粮仓”世界，Brooloo是一个悠闲的世界，遍布着未受冲突波及的大型农场.

column1: Another "quiet and unremarkable" Lyran world, known for its large areas of strong but slow growing native trees, the production of a particularly smooth single malt whisky, and a native fish similar to the sardine that grows to weigh 600lb.
column2: 又一颗“安静而平平无奇”的天琴世界，以其大片坚硬但生长缓慢的原生树木、一种口感格外顺滑的单一麦芽威士忌的酿造，以及一种类似沙丁鱼、能长到600磅重的原生鱼类而闻名.

column1: Antallos III is an arid world with two moons. Following the collapse of the Star League, civilization on Antallos collapsed quickly, and by the thirty-first century the barren wastes ("Free Zones") are home to the worst of humanity.
column2: Antallos III是一颗拥有两颗卫星的干旱世界. 星际联盟崩溃后，Antallos上的文明迅速瓦解，到了三十一世纪，荒芜的废土（“自由区”）已成为人类中最恶劣之辈的栖身之所.

column1: As a commander, you know that to keep your mechwarriors alive, you need to fit the most tonnage onto your mechs that you can, and at Quicsell, we've found a way to help with that. Tradidional life support systems are completely overbuilt, so we stripped them down to half the weight. Your mechwarriors can put up with a little discomfort, right?
column2: 身为指挥官，您很清楚，要让机甲战士活下来，就得尽可能往机甲里塞更多的东西. 而在Quicsell，我们找到了帮您达成目标的方法. 传统的生命维持系统被过度强化了，所以我们将其精简至一半重量. 您的机甲战士稍微忍忍不适，没问题的，对吧?

column1: Ashkum is a minor planet on the Fed/Capellan border.  Recently conquered by the Feds, it remains a typical "border world" - under开发 and over garrisoned.
column2: Ashkum是联邦与卡佩拉边界上的一颗次要星球. 最近被联邦征服后，它仍是一个典型的“边境世界”——欠发达且驻军过多.

column1: At Quicsell, we understand that the bottom line is more important than anything, so we've 设计ed our mech's structure to be as cheap and easy to repair as possible. It's even lighter as a side benefit. Win, win!
column2: 【Structure QS】在Quicsell，我们深知利润底线高于一切，因此我们设计的机甲结构力求成本最低、维修最易. 作为附加好处，它还更轻. 双赢!

column1: At Quicsell, we understand that the bottom line is more important than anything, so we've 设计ed our mech's structure to be as cheap and easy to repair as possible. It's even lighter as a side benifit. Win, win!
column2: 在Quicsell，我们深知利润底线高于一切，因此我们设计的机甲结构力求成本最低、维修最易. 作为附加好处，它还更轻. 双赢!

column1: Aubisson, due to being a moderately important agricultural and manufacturing world on the Combine/Commonwealth border, has changed hands numerous times through its history.  Recently "reclaimed" from the Commonwealth, for now...
column2: Aubisson，由于是位于联合体/共同体边境上的一个中等重要的农业与制造业世界，在其历史上曾多次易手. 最近它从共同体手中被“收复”，至少目前如此……

column1: Ayn Tarma is often described in Colonist's Brochures as a "lucrative mining world" - without mentioning that it is vitally dependent on a lifeline of iceships supplied by Curtiss Hydrosystems - the cost of which is enormous.
column2: Ayn Tarma在《殖民者宣传册》中常被描述为“利润丰厚的矿业世界”——却未提及它极其依赖由Curtiss Hydrosystems供应的冰船生命线——而这条生命线的成本高得惊人.

column1: Balkan was always listed in early Lyran charts as "Marginally Habitable".  When the Combine captured it during the 3rd succession war, they soon discovered what a drain on resources it was, and abandoned it shortly thereafter.
column2: Balkan在早期的天琴星图中一直被列为“勉强宜居”. 当天龙联合体在第三次继承战争期间夺取它时，他们很快发现它有多么消耗资源，并在此后不久放弃了它.

column1: Bass has an excentric orbit, which results in temps varying seasonally up to +/- 70° from a mean of just 5°C.  Most dwellings are in disused mining shafts, including the "Dungeons" - one of Bass's more popular tourist spots for BDSM practitioners.
column2: Bass的轨道偏心，导致温度随季节变化，相较于仅 5°C的平均值上下浮动可达 ±70°C. 大多数住所都位于废弃的矿井竖井中，其中包括“地牢”——Bass较受BDSM实践者欢迎的旅游景点之一.

column1: Battle Armor Mechanical Jump Boosters share the advantages and limitations of their larger cousins. They offer a very limited jump capability and they're hard to steer when in flight. However, the Mechanical Jump Boosters used on Battle Armor offers one significant advantage over their 'Mech sized cousins: They allow the armored infantry soldier to replace the normal walking gait with a longer "bouncing" gait that allows the battle armored trooper to cover more ground.
column2: 战斗装甲机械跳跃助推器继承了其大型版本的优点与局限. 它们提供的跳跃能力非常有限，并且在飞行过程中难以操控. 然而，用于战斗装甲的机械跳跃助推器相比安装在机甲上的同类设备具有一个显著优势: 它们允许装甲步兵用更长距离的‘弹跳’步态替代正常行走步态，使战斗装甲士兵能够覆盖更大的移动范围.

column1: Being deep in Fed space has allowed Capac a "more or less peaceful" existence over the years, which is one of the reasons it was chosen to house a large prison complex.
column2: 由于地处联邦空间深处，Capac多年来得以维持“大致和平”的存在状态，这也是它被选中容纳一座大型监狱综合体的原因之一.

column1: Black Earth was intended to be a "hedgehog", a giant fortified firebase that the Rim Worlds Republic  forces could use to slow the advance of any invading force. Black Earth was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during Republic-Commonwealth War.
column2: Black Earth原本被设想为一座“刺猬”，一个巨大的设防火力基地，边缘世界共和国的部队可用它来迟滞任何入侵部队的推进. Black Earth在共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

column1: Brocchi's Cluster contains what appears to be the remnants of a large planet in the "green zone" of this Class M star, which at some point has exploded into a large asteroid belt.  Over 40 inhabited planetoids and constructs exist in the area.
column2: Brocchi's Cluster中似乎包含一颗位于这颗M型恒星“绿区”内的大型行星的残骸，这颗行星在某时爆炸，形成了一条巨大的小行星带. 该区域内存在 40 多个有人居住的小行星体和构造物.

column1: Butzfleth (AKA "Butt Flesh"), is a minor FWL planet only important because it contains one of the largest prisons in FWL space.  The inhospitable planet is otherwise only inhabited by miners and local support businesses.
column2: Butzfleth（又名“Butt Flesh”）是自由世界联盟的一颗次要行星，其重要性仅在于它拥有自由世界联盟境内最大的监狱之一. 这颗不宜居的行星除此之外只居住着矿工和当地配套商业.

column1: By 2890 the world was marked as associated with the short lived "Duchy of Don't", though by 3022 it was no longer in the maps
column2: 到2890年，该星球被标记为与短命的“Duchy of Don't”有关联，尽管到3022年它已不再出现在地图上.

column1: Candiear is a very "liberal" planet, who's fertile farmlands are just as likely to be producing plants for "recreational purposes" as they are food.  The net result is a distinct "hippy" feel to the planet, and a small tourist trade.
column2: Candiear是一颗非常“自由开放”的星球，其肥沃的农田既可能用于生产粮食，也同样可能用于种植“消遣用途”的植物. 最终结果是这颗星球带有一种独特的“嬉皮士”氛围，以及小规模的旅游业.

column1: Capra was the headquarters world of the XXIII Corps (Star League) of the Star League Defense Force during the final years of the Star League.  As a result, there are the usual rumours of a "hidden cache" that always surround former SLDF bases.
column2: Capra曾是星际联盟末年星际联盟防卫军第XXIII军（星际联盟）的司令部所在星球. 因此，这里也流传着那种总是围绕着前SLDF基地出现的关于“隐秘储备库”的常见传闻.

column1: Captain, this piece is either from a genius or a moron. The maniac put a filter on the output to essentially ''brand'' the target. Even worse they wrote a random generator to always 'paint' something else ... eff these punks!
column2: 船长，这玩意儿不是出自天才之手就是个蠢货造的. 那疯子居然在输出端加了个滤镜，等于给目标“烙上烙印”. 更离谱的是他们还写了个随机生成器，每次都要“画”点不一样的花样……我操这些混蛋!

column1: Carry weight represents the total carry capacity of a 'Mech on top of the normal chassis weight internal capacity. Each hand actuator allows to carry an equivalent of up to 5% chassis maximum tonnage. If a melee weapon is too heavy for a single arm, it can be held two-handed by combining both hands carry capacities.
column2: 携带重量表示机甲在底盘正常内部承载容量之外，额外可携带的总重量. 每个手臂驱动器最多可携带相当于机甲最大底盘吨位 5% 的重量. 如果某件近战武器的重量超过单个手臂的承载能力，则可以通过双手合并携带容量来双手使用该武器.

column1: Cassias is a tropical world located on the Draconis Combine/Federated Suns border. It also acted as the border between the "Outback" and the more densely populated inner systems of the Federated Suns.
column2: Cassias是一颗位于天龙联合体/恒星联邦边境的热带星球. 它也曾是恒星联邦“内陆”与人口更稠密的内层星系之间的边界.

column1: Cerillos is one of the so-called "Southwestern Worlds", an association of three worlds in the Free Worlds League. These agrarian worlds have a unique culture descended from North American Indian and Hispanic peoples.
column2: Cerillos是所谓的“西南世界”之一，这是自由世界联盟中由三个世界组成的联合体. 这些农业世界拥有一种源自北美印第安人和西班牙裔民族的独特文化.

column1: Coming from the same project that experimented with Capacitors on PPCs, this was an attempt to increase the effective range of the Light PPC. Achieving nearly 50% Range increase, it does suffer from a slow Charge Time and increased Minimum Range.
column2: 【Light ER PPC】来自同一个曾在PPC上进行电容器实验的项目  这是一次旨在提高轻型PPC有效射程的尝试. 该武器的射程提升了近 50%  但代价是充能时间较长以及最小射程增加.

column1: Converts a Mech's Cooling System to Clan DHS. The Radical Heat Sink System increases the ability of the heat sink to flush excess heat, much like Coolant Pods. Radical Heat Sinks can fail through repeated use, especially if used continuously.
column2: 【Radical Heat Sink Kit (C)】将机甲的冷却系统转换为氏族双散热器. 激进散热系统可增强散热器排出多余热量的能力，其效果类似于冷却液舱. 激进散热器可能会因反复使用而失效，尤其是在持续使用时.

column1: Converts an SHS engine to Quicsell DHS. A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech. It differs from the closed cooling system of the engine.
column2: 将单散热(SHS)引擎转换为QS双散热(QS DHS)引擎. 机甲的散热系统为机甲内部的组件提供散热，并为遍布机甲的额外散热器提供兼容扩展点. 它不同于引擎本身的封闭式冷却系统.

column1: Converts an SHS engine to Radical CHS. A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech. It differs from the closed cooling system of the engine.
column2: 将单散热(SHS)引擎转换为激进型紧凑散热(激进型CHS)引擎. 机甲的散热系统为机甲内部的组件提供散热，并为遍布机甲的额外散热器提供兼容扩展点. 它不同于引擎本身的封闭式冷却系统.

column1: Converts an SHS engine to Radical PDHS. A Mech' Cooling System provides heat dissipation for components inside the mech and compatible extension points for additional heat sinks throughout the mech. It differs from the closed cooling system of the engine.
column2: 将单散热(SHS)引擎转换为激进型原型双散热(激进型PDHS)引擎. 机甲的散热系统为机甲内部的组件提供散热，并为遍布机甲的额外散热器提供兼容扩展点. 它不同于引擎本身的封闭式冷却系统.

column1: Described as "The happiest place in Lyran space", Breukelen's native flora release pollens that are mildly euphoric to humans.  This has resulted in a significant tourism industry, and a "hippy" culture on the planet.
column2: 被描述为“天琴空间中最幸福的地方”，Breukelen的原生植物会释放令人类产生轻度欣快感的花粉. 这造就了庞大的旅游业，以及该行星上的“嬉皮士”文化.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. After heating up for most of the day, the warm sand increases heat by an additional 4 per turn.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 经过大半天的高温炙烤，滚烫的沙地每回合额外增加 4 点热量.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. In the dark, sight range is significantly reduced.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 在黑暗中，视野范围显著缩短.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. In the dark, sight range is significantly reduced. The fog lowers visibility to 70%, and all units have +1 Defense.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 在黑暗中，视野范围显著缩短. 雾气将能见度降至 70%，所有单位获得 +1 防御.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. In the dim light, sight range is reduced. The fog lowers visibility to 80%, and all units have +1 Defense.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 在昏暗光线下，视野范围缩小. 雾气将能见度降至 80%，所有单位获得 +1 防御.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. In the dim light, sight range is reduced. The setting sun lowers visibility by 10%, and all units have +1 defense.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 在昏暗的光线下，视野范围缩小. 落日将能见度降低 10%，所有单位获得 +1 防御.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. The current extreme weather has further significant impact. Visibility and sensor efficiency are reduced to 50%. Land units take 20% more stability damage and VTOL units have -2 evasion. Weapon scatter radius is increased by 10%. Ballistic and missile weapons have their range reduced by 10%. column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. The extremely high temperature brought on by the heat wave increases heat generation by an additional 25% and 8 heat per turn.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 热浪带来的极端高温使热量生成额外增加 25%，且每回合额外增加 8 点热量.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. The heavy winds cause land units to take 10% more stability damage, and the scatter radius of weapons is increased by 15%. The amount of dust and particles flying around also reduces visibility and sensor efficiency to 90%. All VTOL units have -1 evasion due to more engine thrust needed for stabilizing maneuvers.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 强风导致地面单位承受的稳定性伤害增加 10%，武器散布半径扩大 15%. 飞扬的沙尘和颗粒物还将能见度和传感器效能降低至 90%. 所有垂直起降单位因需要更多引擎推力来稳定机动，闪避值 -1.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. The high amounts of salt and other minerals improve sensor efficiency by 5% and energy weapon damage by 10%. The flat ground makes it easier for '机甲s and wheeled 载具s to move around, reducing their movement cost by 10%.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 高浓度的盐分和其他矿物质将传感器效能提升 5%，能量武器伤害提高 10%. 平坦的地面使机甲与轮式车辆移动更便捷，移动消耗降低 10%.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. The large amounts of dry quicksand increase movement cost for '机甲s and wheeled 载具s by 10% and stability damage for all land units by 20%.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 大量干燥流沙使机甲和轮式车辆的移动消耗增加 10%，所有地面单位承受的稳定性伤害增加 20%.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. This area has experienced some form of nuclear explosion in the past and the heavy, lingering radiation has many detrimental effects. Heat sinking is reduced by 12 per turn, and all units take 20% more damage. Sensors are heavily scrambled and only work at 40% efficiency, and fire control systems have trouble locking on, resulting in -2 accuracy.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 此区域过去曾经历过某种形式的核爆炸，残留的强烈辐射带来了诸多有害影响. 每回合散热能力降低 12 点，所有单位承受伤害增加 20%. 传感器受到严重干扰，效能仅剩 40%，火控系统难以锁定目标，导致命中精度 -2.

column1: Desert biomes decrease heat sinking efficiency to 85%. Whipping dust reduces visibility and sensor efficiency to 60%, and all units have +2 Defense. Strong winds result in land units taking 20% more stability damage, while VTOL units have -2 max evasion. Heat generation is increased by 10%.
column2: 沙漠环境将散热效率降低至 85%. 漫天沙尘将能见度与传感器效能降至 60%，所有单位获得 +2 防御. 强风导致地面单位承受的稳定性伤害增加 20%，而垂直起降飞行器单位的最大闪避值 -2. 热量生成增加 10%.

column1: Developed by Howa Machinery Company Ltd. for the King Dragon, the experimental Ryujin Superheavy Flamer utilizes a totally new concept for delivery of the flammable substance. The weapon charges a 'cloud' of inert nano-particles with an positive charge, which then binds a special ionized highly flammable substance between the particles. Upon impact with a surface the bindings of the nano-particles and the flammable substance are broken, resulting in the ignition of the fluid by the released electrical charge. This allows the flamer to reach much further distances, but also means the heat explosion is considerably less at shorter distances as the kinetic impact will rupture less of the bindings. If the weapon is handled incorrectly it could lead to an incorrect charging sequence resulting in the flammable substance igniting upon firing, causing a large heat explosion. 使用 Superheavy Flamer 弹药.
column2: 【Ryuujin Superheavy Flamer】由Howa Machinery Company Ltd.为King Dragon研发的实验型龙神超重型喷火器采用了一种全新的可燃物质投送方式. 该武器会为一团惰性纳米粒子“云”充入正电荷  然后让一种特殊的电离高可燃性物质结合在粒子之间. 撞击表面时  纳米粒子与可燃物质之间的结合会断裂  释放的电荷随即点燃液体. 这使喷火器能够达到远得多的射程  但也意味着在较短距离下产生的热爆炸会明显减弱  因为动能冲击只能破坏较少的结合. 如果操作不当  可能导致错误的充能过程  使可燃物质在开火时被点燃  从而引发剧烈的热爆炸. 使用超重型喷火器弹药.

column1: Developed by the Clans, Enhanced Imaging or EI is an advanced targeting and piloting system for use with humanoid shaped combat 载具s such as Battle机甲s, battle 装甲 and Proto机甲s. While offering considerable advantages, as well as serving as the only viable control method for Proto机甲s, EI inflicts serious side effects on the user, including possible mental instability, nerve damage and death.
column2: 增强成像（EI）由氏族研发，是一种先进的瞄准与驾驶系统，适用于人形战斗车辆，如战斗机甲、战斗装甲和原型机甲. 虽然它提供了显著的优势，并且是操控原型机甲唯一可行的方式，但EI也会对使用者造成严重的副作用，包括可能的精神不稳定、神经损伤甚至死亡.

column1: Developed to fulfill the Star League's requirement for a quick response VTOL aircraft that could carry a squad of infantry and their equipment, the Ripper normally carries elite infantry or Jump Infantry that need quick deployment or retrieval.  The Ripper, built from proven components for maximum reliability, uses a fusion engine to give the 载具 a significant range, as well as a high top speed, so much so that the infantry compartment is equipped with special acceleration couches to handle the strain of a high speed combat insertion. While the Ripper is heavily 装甲ed for a transport VTOL, carrying one and a half tons of Aldis Heavy ferro-fibrous plating to survive the high G maneuvers that are the hallmark of the craft, a small laser or even a well-equipped infantry squad can down the 载具 in short order.
column2: 撕裂者（Ripper）是为满足星盟对一种快速响应VTOL航空器的需求而开发的，该航空器能够搭载一个步兵小队及其装备. 撕裂者通常搭载需要快速部署或撤离的精锐步兵或跳跃步兵. 撕裂者采用经过验证的组件制造，以实现最大可靠性，并使用聚变引擎为车辆提供较远的航程以及极高的速度. 因此，其步兵舱配备了特殊的加速座椅，以承受高速战斗部署时产生的巨大过载. 虽然作为一款运输型VTOL，撕裂者拥有相当厚重的装甲，装备了1.5吨Aldis重型铁纤维装甲，以承受这种飞行器标志性的高G机动，但一门小型激光，甚至一支装备精良的步兵小队，都能在短时间内将其击落.

column1: El Dorado was vital to the commercial empire being built by Adam Davion and which laid much of the groundwork for the future Federated Suns. Has a number of "Super Lakes"
column2: El Dorado对亚当·戴维恩正在建立的商业帝国至关重要，该帝国为未来的恒星联邦奠定了大量基础. 拥有多个“超级湖泊”.

column1: Enhanced Imaging Neural Implants formed part of the Clans' Enhanced Imaging system and were useful only when combined with a Battle机甲, Proto机甲 or Battle 装甲 equipped with an Enhanced Imaging Display. The implants themselves consisted of electronic sensors, fiber-optic wires and contact points connected to a warrior's central nervous system. Implanted just below the skin they were visible as faintly luminous lines in colors such as red, blue or green.
column2: 增强成像神经植入物是氏族增强成像系统的一部分，只有在与配备增强成像显示器的战斗机甲、原型机甲或战斗装甲结合时才能发挥效用. 植入物本身由电子传感器、光纤导线和连接至战士中枢神经系统的接触点组成. 它们被植入皮下，外观呈现为淡红色、蓝色或绿色的微光纹路.

column1: Ferro Spall Shielding is reminiscent of ancient bluewater battleship citadel armoring schemes where critical components are armored far more heavily; where this would normally be catastrophically too heavy, Ferro Spall Shielding utilizes both Endo-Steel and Ferro-Fibrous technologies to significantly reduce the burden.
column2: 【Ferro Spall Shield】铁鳞护盾让人联想到古代蓝水海军战列舰的核心区装甲方案，即对关键部件进行远比其他区域更厚重的装甲防护; 若采用传统方式，这种设计通常会重得难以承受，而铁鳞护盾同时采用钢内骨结构和铁纤维技术，大幅减轻了这一负担.

column1: Fire selected weapons at any target within this unit's current firing arc.
column2: 向本单位当前射界内的任意目标使用选定武器开火.

column2: 游戏中集齐全部的独特机体时，你会获得25，000分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数. 这里不包括扩展包中引入的机体.

column1: For each active Alliance, you gain 7500 points. This value is then multiplied by the score modifier.
column2: 对于每个生效的同盟，你会获得7500分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column1: For each completed Argo upgrade, you gain 2000 points. This value is then multiplied by the score modifier.
column2: 对于每项已完成的阿尔戈号升级项目，你会获得2000分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column2: 对于每个已完成的合约，每一级合约难度你会获得50分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column2: 对于每个与你的声望达到最大值或最小值的派系，你会获得10，000分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column1: For each point of Mercenary Review Board reputation, you gain 45 points. This value is then multiplied by the score modifier.
column2: 对于每一点佣兵评委会评级，你会获得45分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column2: 对于每一点士气，你会获得500分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column2: 对于每一点任一派系的负面声望，你会获得100分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column2: 对于每一点任一派系的正面声望，你会获得100分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column2: 对于每个你造访过的星系(最多有170个星系)，你会获得500分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column1: For each unique chassis in your Mech Bay or cargo hold, you earn 1273 points. This value is then multiplied by the score modifier. This does not include chassis introduced in expansion content.
column2: 对于你机甲舱或仓库里的每一种独特机体，你都会获得1273分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数. 这里不包括扩展包中引入的机体.

column1: For each weight class of 'Mech (Assault, Heavy, Medium, or Light) for which you've collected every unique chassis, you gain a bonus of 10,000 points per weight class completed.   This value is then multiplied by the score modifier.

column2: 当达到佣兵评委会最高评级时，你会获得25，000奖励分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column1: For visiting 170 star systems, you gain a bonus of 25,000 points. This value is then multiplied by the score modifier.
column2: 当造访了170个星系时，你会获得25，000奖励分. 然后这一分数再乘以总分系数.

column1: Hardened Armor is a thicker armor type that uses multiple overlapping plates to provide additional protection against enemy fire. Though capable of diverting more damage than standard armor, the increased number of armor plates and their lack of flexibility makes any unit employing it more difficult to pilot, and can affect the speed as well. Activatable: DEALS DAMAGE AND CRIT TO CENTER TORSO ON FAILURE
column2: 加固装甲是一种更厚的装甲类型，使用多层重叠的装甲板来提供额外的防护以抵御敌方火力. 尽管它能比标准装甲偏转更多伤害，但增加的装甲板数量及其缺乏灵活性使得使用它的任何单位更难以驾驶，并且也会影响速度. 可激活: 失败时对中央躯干造成伤害和暴击

column1: Having trouble spotting those sneaky Capellans without breaking the bank with overpriced sensors? Try Quicsell's integrated Sensors Searchlight today and see exactly how screwed you are!
column2: 是不是觉得那些昂贵的传感器太烧钱，可又总发现不了那群鬼鬼祟祟的卡佩拉佬? 今天就试试Quicsell的一体化传感器探照灯，亲眼看清楚自己到底有多狼狈!

column1: Ion Stream Projectors an offshoot of PPC development where, rather than focusing the ion and proton streams into a single devastating shot, ISPs only have the minimum of field inhibitors and beam focusing equipment. With supplemental superheated plasma from the engine, this results in a spray of energized particles that more closely resembles a flamer than a traditional PPC.
column2: 【Ion Stream Projector】离子流投射器是PPC发展的一个分支，它不像传统PPC那样将离子和质子流聚焦成单一毁灭性射击，而是只配备最低限度的场抑制器和光束聚焦设备. 借助来自引擎的补充过热等离子体，这会产生一片高能粒子喷流，看起来更像是火焰喷射器而非传统PPC.

column1: Is that...11 laser tags...held together by rubber bands and glue...mounted to the rotating shaft from the remains of lathe? I give up. Pirates are truly insane.
column2: 那是……十一个激光TAG……用橡皮筋和胶水绑在一起……装在一台车床残骸的旋转轴上? 我认输了. 海盗们真是一群疯子.

column1: It looks like someone combined the burned out and broken parts of two PPCs to create one barely-functional PPC. The electromagnetic field generation is unstable. You're likely to get zapped if you walk too close to this thing.
column2: 【PPC (P)】看起来有人把两门PPC烧毁且损坏的部件拼凑在一起，制造出了一门勉强能运作的PPC. 电磁场生成极不稳定. 你最好不要离这东西太近，否则很可能会被电到.

column1: It's a small gesture, but even a little attention helps. Soon requests come pouring in from the crew for books and periodicals originating in systems all across the Periphery and the Inner Sphere.
column2: 这虽是个小举动，但即使一点点关注也会有所帮助. 很快，船员对产自外围和内天体各个星系的书籍和期刊的需求就蜂拥而至.

column1: It's not a 'containment failure', it's a 'surprise feature'! Now you'll have a much easier time hitting moving targets with a ppc.
column2: 这不是“约束失效”，这是“惊喜功能”! 现在你用PPC击中移动目标会容易得多.

column1: It's not hard to find an unoccupied corner of the Argo big enough to lay out a spread of food and an impromptu dance floor. Although the mercenaries are from all corners of the Periphery and the Inner Sphere, drink and music manage to bridge all differences, and a good time is had by all.
column2: 在阿尔戈号 上，找到一个足够大，可以摆下各种食物和一个临时舞池的空置角落并不难. 虽然雇佣兵们来自外围和内天体的各个角落，但饮料和音乐成功弥合了所有差异，让所有人都度过一段美好时光.

column1: Jubka has been described as a "lucrative mining world" that is however vitally dependant on a lifeline of iceships supplied by Curtiss Hydrosystems.
column2: Jubka被描述为一个“利润丰厚的采矿星球”，但它却极其依赖由Curtiss Hydrosystems供应的冰船生命线.

column1: Jump Jet Lite! Only half the weight, and nearly the same power as a normal jumpjet. Buy a value pack today and get double discounts!
column2: 轻量版跳跃喷口！重量仅一半，动力与普通跳跃喷口几乎相同. 今天就买超值套装，享受双倍折扣！

column1: Kirei Na Niwa ("Beautiful Garden") is a world whose economy is largely based on agriculture. The broad plains and fertile soil allow many crops to be grown here year round.
column2: Kirei Na Niwa（“美丽花园”）是一个经济主要依赖农业的星球. 广袤的平原和肥沃的土壤使这里全年都能种植多种作物.

column1: Large amounts of rubble and debris increase stability damage and movement cost by 10%. All units have +1 Defense.
column2: 大量碎石瓦砾使稳定性伤害与移动消耗增加 10%. 所有单位获得 +1 防御.

column1: Larger than LRMs, Fire and Forget missiles utilize their size to house a stronger payload and better guidance systems.
column2: 【Ammo Fire and Forget】发射后不管导弹比LRM更大，利用其尺寸容纳更强的有效载荷和更好的制导系统.

column1: Later that week, Dr. Murad enters your office. "Bad news, Commander. The patch only partially worked. To maintain minimal gravity support, I'm going to insist we shut down the rotation for several hours each day until we can get a permanent fix. I let the staff know about the situation, and they seemed annoyed for some reason. But on the bright side, no MechWarriors were incapacitated by this!"
column2: 本周晚些时候，穆拉德博士走进你的办公室.“坏消息，指挥官. 修复并不完全成功. 为了维持最基本的重力支撑，我必须坚持每天关闭旋转舱数小时，直到我们能找到永久解决方案. 我已经把情况告诉了机组人员，他们似乎因此感到不满. 但好消息是，没有任何机甲机师因此失能！”

column1: Leave it to Pirates to fail at fixing up a Emergency Coolant System and instead hotwire it externally directly into the coolant System.... VOLATILE!.
column2: 也只有海盗能把紧急冷却系统修砸了，反而从外部直接把它搭线接到冷却系统上…… 易爆!

column1: Massive rounds, designed for devastating impact, to be used in the Yang artillery.
column2: 巨型炮弹，专为毁灭性打击而设计，用于杨氏火炮.

column1: Massive rounds, designed for interfering with enemy internal systems, to be used in the Yang artillery.
column2: 巨型炮弹，专为干扰敌方内部系统而设计，用于杨氏火炮.

column1: Mech Grenade Launcher rounds are low-velocity, high-explosive projectiles able to damage several units on impact. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
column2: 机甲榴弹发射器子弹是低速、高爆炸弹，能够在撞击时损坏多个单位。受到致命一击后，弹药箱内储存的任何剩余弹药都会爆炸，对安装位置造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E 可以降低风险。

column1: Mia Thompson, callsign "Reaper", was drafted into the Steiner military after her family was killed in a pirate raid. Mia, as a 12-year-old child, climbed into her father's AgroMech - a Cattlemaster used for farming - and fought off the pirates alone for over an hour before help arrived. After that, she was drafter and raised in the military. Her natural talent and understanding has seen her quickly rise through the ranks as a respected MechWarrior. These days, however, she prefers to choose her own path, and left Steiner after her last campaign.\\n\\n
column2: 米娅·汤普森（Mia Thompson），呼号“死神”，在她的家人在一次海盗袭击中丧生后被征召入伍。 12 岁的米娅 (Mia) 爬进了父亲的 AgroMech（一种用于耕种的 Cattlemaster），独自与海盗战斗了一个多小时，然后救援人员才赶到。此后，她成为起草者并在军队长大。她的天赋和理解力使她迅速晋升为受人​​尊敬的机甲战士。然而如今，她更愿意选择自己的道路，并在上次竞选后离开了施泰纳。\\n\\n

column1: Michael Fastback, renowned as "Razor", is a battle-hardened MechWarrior known for his lightning-fast reflexes and precision in combat. Hailing from a lineage of MechWarriors, he inherited an affinity for piloting BattleMechs at an early age. Today, his expertise in piloting and tactical finesse make him a formidable adversary, able to swiftly engage and disengage with deadly efficiency.\\n\\n
column2: 迈克尔·法斯特巴克（Michael Fastback），绰号“剃刀”，是一位久经沙场的机甲战士，以其闪电般的反应速度和战斗精确度而闻名。他出身机甲战士血统，从小就继承了驾驶战机的爱好。如今，他在驾驶和战术技巧方面的专业知识使他成为令人畏惧的对手，能够以致命的效率快速交战和脱离交战。\\n\\n

column1: Wheeled units 拥有their movement cost reduced by 5% 在 urban environments. In the dark, sight 射程 是significantly reduced. 该fog reduces visibility 以 70%, 和 all units 拥有+1 Defense.
column2: 在城市环境中，轮式单位的移动消耗降低 5%. 在黑暗中，视野范围显著缩短. 雾气将能见度降至 70%，所有单位获得 +1 防御.

column1: Wheeled units 拥有their movement cost reduced by 5% 在 urban environments. In the dim light, sight 射程 是reduced. 该fog reduces visibility 以 80%, 和 all units 拥有+1 Defense.
column2: 在城市环境中，轮式单位的移动消耗降低 5%. 在昏暗光线下，视野范围缩小. 雾气将能见度降至 80%，所有单位获得 +1 防御.

column1: Quicsell's Double Autocannons have all the power of a top of the line Ultra Autocannon for a fraction of the price, and your second shot is guaranteed to follow your first. \\n\\nUses AC5 Ammo.
column2: Quicsell 的双自动炮拥有顶级超级自动炮的所有威力，而价格却只是其一小部分，并且保证您的第二次射击会紧接着您的第一次射击。 \\n\\n使用AC5弹药。

column1: Quicsell's innovative LBX laser series makes it much more likely to hit a moving target. The accusations from our competitors that we are simply looking for a way to use up cracked focusing chambers from sub-par construction techniques are slander, pure and simple.
column2: Quicsell 的创新 LBX 激光器系列使其更有可能击中移动目标。我们的竞争对手指责我们只是在寻找一种方法来利用低于标准的施工技术的破裂聚焦室，这是纯粹的诽谤。

column1: Quicsell's patented 'Guard-dog' Electronic Warfare Suite is guaranteed to be just as powerful at protecting your hide as our overpriced competitors.
column2: Quicsell专利“看门狗”电子战套件，保证拥有与那些价格高得离谱的竞争对手产品同等强大的防护能力.

column1: Quicsell's strongest energy punch. Smack someone from across the map with the damage of an AC20! The ultimate in long range firepower. \\n\\n Damage reduced dramatically at close range.
column2: 奎塞尔最强的能量拳。用 AC20 的伤害打击地图另一边的某人！终极远程火力。 \\n\\n 近距离伤害大幅降低。

column1: Quizel Narf has been described as either one of the greatest or one of the worst pirate lords to have ever graced the history books.\\n\\nBorn on a backwater world in the Circinus Federation, Narf grew up hearing stories of daring raids, buried treasure, and fortunes won and lost. Enthralled by these tales, even if most weren't true, Narf quickly decided the pirate's life was for him and, at the young age of 17, joined his first pirate crew.\\n\\nThere Narf stood above his peers, proving to be both cunning, fearless, and a natural at finding hidden 'booty'. These qualities soon found Narf rising through the ranks of command until the age of 26, when the entire crew he was serving under was wiped out in a Lyran sting operation.\\n\\nBarely escaping himself, Narf decided to start his own crew instead of joining someone else's. It was here that Narf's true talent was discovered: his ability to recruit people to his cause. Such was his talent that before his 30th birthday, Narf found himself a pirate lord, having recruited enough people to create and run no less than a dozen different crews - all under his command.\\n\\nDespite his disdain for politics, Narf's power meant he was a household name within the loosely governed Federation, and he soon found himself a central figure of it. It is here that the Federation's craze with raccoons is said to have come from, as Narf was so fond of the Terran raccoon that he underwent numerous surgeries in the nearby Magistracy of Canopus until he outwardly looked like one.\\n\\nUpon learning of the Clan invasion of the Inner Sphere, Narf fantasized of leading the Federation to become a Clan itself, less out of a desire to be recognized as a member of a warrior-people and more because he thought it would be funny and would annoy other Clans to no end. A mere five years later, taking full advantage of the Word of Blake's Jihad, Narf and his crews manged to pull off one of the greatest feats any pirate ever has: not only landing on - but sacking - Strana Mechty itself. While Clan reinforcements drove the pirates off-world within hours and years later altered their histories to state the sacking never happened, it did not stop Narf from proclaiming himself Khan of a new Clan known as "Skull-Squid". While no Clan would ever recognize the claim - in fact, some actively attempted to kill the now infamous pirate lord - it did not stop Narf or his crews from using the term whenever possible.\\n\\nThat is not to say all of Narf's plans went off without a hitch, and one of his greatest failures came with his alliance to Hans O'Reilly and his attempt to help place him on the throne of the Marian Hegemony. When the Circinus invasion badly backfired, Narf's legendary status within the Federation was dimmed for several years.\\n\\nNarf's final fate is not clear. What is known is that the Republic of the Sphere attacked and tried to murder him during his own wedding, successfully assassinating his bride-to-be. Reports from the time are hazy, and it is not clear one way or another if Narf himself was killed. For years after the incident, sightings of the famous Raccoon-Pirate continued to occur, and the Federation itself grew fat off the pirate activity as it preyed on the helpless Free Worlds League. However, none of these sightings could ever be confirmed, nor could the enrichment of the Federation be directly tied to Narf.\\n\\nIn the end however, perhaps it doesn't matter if Narf died that day or lived to plunder for years more. His stories were already out there, his exploits both real and made up inspiring new generations of pirates. And after we are gone, our stories are what remain.\\n\\n
column2: 奎泽尔·纳尔夫被描述为历史书上最伟大的海盗领主之一，或者是最糟糕的海盗领主之一。\\n\\n纳尔夫出生在马戏努斯联邦的一个偏僻世界，他从小就听着大胆的袭击、埋藏的宝藏以及财富得失的故事长大。纳尔夫被这些故事所吸引，尽管大多数故事都不是真的，但他很快就决定海盗的生活适合他，并在 17 岁时加入了他的第一批海盗船队。\\n\\n在那里，纳尔夫站在同龄人之上，事实证明他既狡猾、无所畏惧，又天生擅长寻找隐藏的“战利品”。这些品质很快让纳夫在指挥队伍中不断晋升，直到 26 岁，他手下的所有船员都在一次天琴星诱捕行动中被消灭。\\n\\n勉强逃脱的纳夫决定组建自己的船员，而不是加入别人的队伍。正是在这里，纳尔夫的真正才能被发现了：他招募人才加入他的事业的能力。纳夫的天赋如此之高，以至于在他的 30th 生日之前，纳夫发现自己是一名海盗领主，招募了足够多的人来创建和管理至少十几个不同的船员 - 全部都在他的指挥之下。\\n\\n尽管他蔑视政治，纳夫的权力意味着他在管理松散的联邦中是家喻户晓的人物，他很快就发现自己成为了联邦的核心人物。据说联邦对浣熊的狂热正是源于这里，因为纳夫非常喜欢人族浣熊，以至于他在附近的卡诺普斯裁判官接受了无数次手术，直到他外表看起来像浣熊。\\n\\n在得知族群入侵内层后，纳夫幻想着领导联邦本身成为一个族群，更多的是因为他认为这会很有趣，而且会永远惹恼其他族群。仅仅五年后，纳尔夫和他的船员充分利用了布莱克圣战的话语，成功地完成了海盗有史以来最伟大的壮举之一：不仅登陆，而且洗劫了斯特拉纳·梅赫蒂本身。虽然部落增援部队在数小时内将海盗赶出了世界，几年后又改变了他们的历史，声称这次劫掠从未发生过，但这并没有阻止纳夫宣称自己是一个名为“骷髅乌贼”的新部落的可汗。虽然没有一个氏族会承认这一说法——事实上，有些氏族积极试图杀死这位现在臭名昭著的海盗领主——但这并没有阻止纳尔夫或他的船员们尽可能地使用这个词。\\n\\n这并不是说纳尔夫的所有计划都顺利进行，他最大的失败之一是他与汉斯·奥莱利结盟，并试图帮助他登上玛丽安霸权的王座。当Circinus入侵严重适得其反后，纳尔夫在联邦中的传奇地位被暗淡了好几年。\\n\\n纳尔夫的最终命运尚不清楚。已知的是，球体共和国在他自己的婚礼上袭击并试图谋杀他，成功刺杀了他的准新娘。当时的报道很模糊，也不清楚纳尔夫本人是否被杀。事件发生后的许多年里，著名的浣熊海盗的目击事件不断发生，而联邦本身也因海盗活动而发财，因为它掠夺了无助的自由世界联盟。然而，这些目击事件都无法得到证实，联邦的富裕也不能与纳尔夫直接联系起来。 \\n\\n然而，最终，也许纳尔夫是在那一天去世还是继续掠夺多年并不重要。他的故事已经广为人知，他的功绩既真实又鼓舞了新一代的海盗。当我们离开后，我们的故事仍然存在。\\n\\n

column1: Rackam's ragtag crew of pirates arrive with little fanfare. As Yang escorts them to the Mech Bay, they stare in awe at the Argo.\\n\\nRackam limps over and offers his hand. "Always a tough negotiator, {COMMANDER.FirstName}! But our mutual friends have told me good things about your recent activities." Gesturing to the Argo, "So who'd you scam to get this bird? I've got time to hear the whole story."\\n\\nOver the course of the next couple weeks, Rackam's 'Mechs get repaired and his professional scoundrels get to know the Argo's crew. While they don't initially have much in common, Rackam's vast selection of hard-to-find Holovids gives them plenty to talk about.
column2: 拉卡姆的一群乌合之众海盗悄然抵达。当杨护送他们前往机甲湾时，他们敬畏地盯着 Argo。\\n\\n拉卡姆一瘸一拐地走过去，伸出了手。 “{COMMANDER.FirstName}，总是一个强硬的谈判者！但我们共同的朋友告诉我关于你最近的活动的好消息。”指着阿尔戈号，“那么你骗了谁来得到这只鸟？我有时间听听整个故事。”\\n\\n在接下来的几周里，拉卡姆的机甲得到修复，他的职业恶棍们开始了解 Argo 的船员。虽然它们最初并没有太多共同点，但拉卡姆精选的大量难以找到的全息灯让它们有很多值得讨论的地方。

column1: Rackam's ragtag crew of pirates arrive with little fanfare. As Yang escorts them to the Mech Bay, they stare in awe at the Argo.\\n\\nRackam limps over. "You've got a very interesting bird here, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Do I get a tour?"\\n\\n"Of course. I only wish I could provide more support from the Mech Bay." Gesturing broadly as you make your way deeper into the ship, "Even with all of this, there's one thing that hasn't changed. It's the 'Mechs that make the money."
column2: 拉卡姆的一群乌合之众海盗悄然抵达。当杨护送他们前往机甲湾时，他们敬畏地盯着 Argo。\\n\\n拉卡姆一瘸一拐地走了过来。 “这里有一只非常有趣的鸟，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我可以参观吗？”\\n\\n“当然。我只希望我能从机甲湾提供更多支持。”当你深入飞船时，你做了一个大手势，“即使发生了这一切，有一件事没有改变。那就是‘赚钱的机甲’。”

column1: Raised on a mercenary stronghold on Cassia, Julia grew up surrounded by BattleMechs with her sister Amanda. They were both later trained at the renowned Blackstar Academy, becoming highly skilled MechWarriors. Julia's elegant finesse and innately protective nature earned her the moniker "Angel", while her sister's fiery nature and daring approach earned her the callsign "Firefly". A falling-out over the morality of a complex mission caused the sisters to go their seperate ways. However, they still hold an unbreakable bond, and maybe one day they will reconcile.\\n\\n
column2: 朱莉娅在卡西亚的一个雇佣兵据点长大，与姐姐阿曼达一起在机甲战车的包围下长大。他们后来都在著名的黑星学院接受训练，成为技艺高超的机甲战士。朱莉娅优雅的技巧和与生俱来的保护性为她赢得了“天使”的绰号，而她姐姐火热的性格和大胆的做法为她赢得了“萤火虫”的呼号。姐妹俩因执行一项复杂任务的道德问题而发生争执，结果分道扬镳。然而，他们仍然保持着牢不可破的联系，也许有一天他们会和解。\\n\\n

column1: Raising your voice, you say, "Well, that last contract was brutal. I didn't think we'd make it back."\\n\\nDarius stifles his confusion and plays along. "Yeah, that was a rough one. We had to hose good MechWarriors out of their cockpits."\\n\\nYou glance at your captive, silent audience.\\n\\n"We'll need fresh meat. Those kids look like they know their way around a BattleMech. Hey! Want to join our mercenary company? You'll go to interesting planets, meet interesting people, and shoot them."\\n\\nThe nobles fall over themselves to pay the tab and flee the bar.\\n\\nDarius finally lets loose laughter he'd been holding in. "{COMMANDER.FirstName}, not every noble is cut out for a life of excitement. Probably for the best."
column2: 你提高声音说：“嗯，最后一份合同是 brutal。我不认为我们会回来。”\\n\\nDarius 抑制住了他的困惑，继续玩下去。 “是的，这很艰难。我们必须把优秀的机甲战士从他们的驾驶舱里赶出来。”\\n\\n你看了一眼被俘虏的、沉默的观众。\\n\\n“我们需要 新鲜的肉。那些孩子看起来他们熟悉机甲战。嘿！想加入我们的雇佣兵连吗？你会去有趣的星球，遇到有趣的人，然后射击\\n\\n贵族们拼命付账，然后逃离了酒吧。\\n\\n大流士终于放声大笑起来。“{COMMANDER.FirstName}，并不是每个贵族都适合过刺激的生活，也许是最好的。”

column1: Ray Headley, or "Jockstrap", had it all - the fame, the fortune, and the love of the crowd. He's best known as the Star Gladiator for the Golden Suns, a Solaris team with an impressively high record of coring out 'Mech engines. He unceremoniously earned his nickname when, during a match against an opposing team of Urbanmechs, a bump on the cockpit of his Firestarter dislodged the MechWarrior from his seat right into his good-luck trophy. The object slammed between him and the cockpit, opening mic channels and breaking his communications relay as he yelled out to world those infamous words: "...Thank God I remembered my Jockstrap!"\\n\\n
column2: 雷·海德利（Ray Headley），又名“Jockstrap”，拥有一切——名声、财富和群众的喜爱。他最出名的身份是金太阳队的明星角斗士，这是一支索拉里斯队，在机甲引擎方面有着令人印象深刻的高记录。在与对方的 Urbanmechs 队的比赛中，他的 Firestarter 驾驶舱发生碰撞，将 MechWarrior 从座位上撞到了他的好运奖杯上，因此他毫不客气地赢得了这个绰号。该物体猛烈地撞击在他和驾驶舱之间，打开了麦克风通道并中断了他的通讯中继，同时他向世界喊出了那些臭名昭著的话语：“……感谢上帝，我记得我的护体裤！”\\n\\n

column1: Realizing he will get no handouts from your table, Rance moves on. The stench of fear and desperation lingers long after he's gone.\\n\\nGlancing at your face, Darius cocks an eyebrow. "Why do I get the feeling there's a story here?"\\n\\nBy the time you finish your tale of betrayal and revenge, the table is covered with empty glasses and the lights are low.\\n\\nDarius finally leans back and whistles appreciatively. "Commander, I don't know if I would've shown such restraint if I were in your shoes. That said, he'll never stop running. You've given him a lifetime of looking over his shoulder."
column2: 兰斯意识到他不会从你的桌子上得到任何施舍，于是继续前进。在他离开后，恐惧和绝望的恶臭依然挥之不去。\\n\\n德莱厄斯看了一眼你的脸，扬起一边眉毛。 “为什么我感觉这里有一个故事？”\\n\\n当你讲完你的背叛和复仇的故事时，桌子上摆满了空玻璃杯，灯光昏暗。\\n\\nDarius 终于向后靠了靠，赞赏地吹了声口哨。 “指挥官，我不知道如果我是你，我是否还会表现得如此克制。话虽如此，他永远不会停止奔跑。你给了他一生的监视。”

column1: Recently taken from the Combine, Asta is a world that refuses to die, in spite of being ravaged by WMD in the days of the Amaris Empire, and being a battleground recently.  It is a highly agrarian "breadbasket" planet.
column2: Asta最近刚从联合体手中被夺取，它是一个拒绝死亡的世界，尽管在阿马里斯帝国时期曾遭到大规模杀伤性武器的揉躏，并且最近还成为了战场. 它是一颗高度农业化的“粮仓”行星.

column1: Regardless of an AutoMech's design, it receives three CPU critical slots in its Head hit location. Two of these slots - replacing the Life Support Slots on a standard BattleMech cockpit - are identified as Secondary CPUs, while the third - replacing the Cockpit critical slot - is the Primary CPU. Collectively, these represent the AutoMech's brain.
column2: 无论 AutoMech 的设计如何，它的头部命中位置都会接收三个 CPU 关键插槽。其中两个插槽（替换标准 BattleMech 驾驶舱上的生命支持插槽）被识别为辅助 CPU，而第三个插槽（替换驾驶舱关键插槽）是主 CPU。总的来说，这些代表了 AutoMech 的大脑。

column1: Regardless of an Automech's design, it receives three CPU critical slots in its Head hit location. Two of these slots - replacing the Life Support Slots on a standard BattleMech cockpit - are identified as Secondary CPU's, while the third - replacing the Cockpit critical slot - is the primary CPU. Collectively, these represent the Automech's brain.
column2: 无论 Automech 的设计如何，它的头部命中位置都会接收三个 CPU 关键插槽。其中两个插槽（替换标准 BattleMech 驾驶舱上的生命支持插槽）被识别为辅助 CPU，而第三个插槽（替换驾驶舱关键插槽）是主 CPU。总的来说，这些代表了 Automech 的大脑。

column1: Regardless of an AutoMech's design, it receives three CPU critical slots in its Head hit location. Two of these slots - replacing the Life Support Slots on a standard BattleMech cockpit - are identified as Secondary CPUs, while the third - replacing the Cockpit critical slot - is the Primary CPU. Collectively, these represent the AutoMech's brain. This Primary CPU has been augmented with a command Module to assist in coordination of movement of mass haulers. It also is very capable of waging an extended war.
column2: 无论 AutoMech 的设计如何，它的头部命中位置都会接收三个 CPU 关键插槽。其中两个插槽（替换标准 BattleMech 驾驶舱上的生命支持插槽）被识别为辅助 CPU，而第三个插槽（替换驾驶舱关键插槽）是主 CPU。总的来说，这些代表了 AutoMech 的大脑。该主 CPU 已通过命令模块进行了增强，以协助协调土方搬运车的移动。它也非常有能力发动长期战争。

column1: Remove UNSTEADY and end this unit's turn. Gain BULWARK (20% damage reduction against ranged attacks to the front and side) and ENTRENCHED (50% stability damage reduction).
column2: 移除失衡状态并结束本单位的回合. 获得“戒备”(减免20%正面与侧面受到的远程攻击伤害) 和“稳固”(稳定性伤害减免50%).

column1: Remove UNSTEADY and end this unit's turn. Gain GUARDED (10% damage reduction against ranged attacks to the front and side) and ENTRENCHED (50% stability damage reduction).
column2: 移除失衡状态并结束本单位的回合. 获得“戒备”(减免10%正面与侧面受到的远程攻击伤害) 和“稳固”(稳定性伤害减免50%).

column1: Resisting the urge to randomly turn off individual systems, you give the single emergency shut-off a decisive pull. The emergency breaker kicks in with an audible pop.\\n\\nA disquieting silence fills the Mech Bay. Yang casts a discerning eye over the {SCN_UNIT.Chassis.Description.Name} and the other 'Mechs in this bay, then calls down to you. "Sorry Boss, but our current projects are going to be in the shop longer than planned."
column2: 为了抵制随机关闭单个系统的冲动，您对单个紧急关闭施加了决定性的推动力。紧急断路器随着一声爆裂声启动。\\n\\n机甲湾充满了令人不安的寂静。杨以敏锐的目光审视了这个海湾中的 {SCN_UNIT.Chassis.Description.Name} 和其他机甲，然后向下呼叫你。 “抱歉，老板，我们目前的项目在商店里的停留时间将比计划的要长。”

column1: RISC Engineers took a retake on the 'failed' NAIS Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle and refit it to fire a extremely dense cluster of shots, showering the target area in a dense deadly shrapnel shroud. Uses Heavy Gauss Ammo. VOLATILE!
column2: RISC的工程师们重新审视了NAIS银弹高斯步枪这一“失败”方案，将其改造为可发射一簇极高密度弹丸的武器，以致命的弹片云覆盖目标区域. 使用重型高斯弹药. 易爆!

column1: Rob Werner, callsign "Toga", lacks finesse in the finer aspects of war, but more than makes up for it sheer brutality. Often seen charging headfirst into the enemy line, Toga revels in flanking the enemy backline and having his way with the rear and side armor of long-range artillery units. He paints his trademark green striped camouflage, Omega Toga Pattern, on his 'Mechs, which he believes is the key to successfully fooling opponent. To his foes, it's as if he just springs up from around them, seemingly out of thin air, preceding the blood-curdling screams which in turn are followed by complete radio silence.\\n\\n
column2: 罗布·沃纳（Rob Werner），呼号“Toga”，在战争的细节方面缺乏技巧，但足以弥补其纯粹的残酷。人们经常看到托加一头冲进敌方阵线，他热衷于从侧翼包抄敌人的后线，并利用远程炮兵部队的后部和侧面装甲。他在自己的“机甲”上涂上了自己标志性的绿色条纹迷彩“欧米茄托加图案”，他认为这是成功愚弄对手的关键。对于他的敌人来说，他就像是从他们周围突然出现，似乎是凭空而来，在令人毛骨悚然的尖叫声之后，接下来是完全的无线电静默。\\n\\n

column1: Rolling clouds of heavy pollution decrease heat sinking efficiency to 95%. Visibility and sensor efficiency is reduced to 80%. All units have +1 Defense.
column2: 滚滚而来的重度污染云雾将散热效率降低至 95%. 能见度与传感器效能降至 80%. 所有单位获得 +1 防御.

column1: Ruby Rhod is a famous host of a 2 hour radio show hosted on and sponsored by the travel company Fhloston Paradise, with over fifty billion people of The Federated Commonwealth's population listening to his show. He has very unorthodox wardrobe and exotic fashion sense. In many ways, he acts in a girlish manner when exposed to combat or is simply annoyed by your presence.
column2: Ruby Rhod 是旅游公司 Fhloston Paradise 主办并赞助的两小时广播节目的著名主持人，联邦联邦人口超过 500 亿人收听他的节目。他有非常非正统的衣柜和异国情调的时尚感。在很多方面，当他遇到战斗时，或者只是因为你的存在而感到恼火时，他的行为举止都像女孩子一样。

column1: S.H.I.T.S. : Severe Hazardous Irritable Taco Syndrome is a medical condition wherein a persons inner gut has an inflamatory reaction to the ingredients used when attempting to create a Taco Truck Taco without the proper recipe.
column2: S.H.I.T.S.: 严重危险刺激性塔可综合征是一种医学状况，即当一个人在没有正确配方的情况下尝试制作塔可餐车塔可时，其肠道内壁对所用食材产生炎症反应.

column1: Safely back on the Argo, Sumire watches the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} news feeds. "Looks like this particular pop-up shop is shut down. It's on all the networks. I give the cabal 24 hours before a new one opens, though."\\n\\nDarius is reading updates from less public information sources. "Bad news, team. From the rumblings on the pirate forums, they're linking the raid back to us."\\n\\nYang crosses his arms over his chest. "Dammit people! Iron Beard will have to retire. This reflects poorly on his criminal character."
column2: 安全返回阿尔戈号后，堇观看了 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 新闻推送。 “看起来这个特定的快闪店被关闭了。它在所有网络上都有。不过，我给阴谋集团 24 小时时间，然后再开一家新店。”\\n\\nDarius 正在从不太公开的信息来源阅读更新。 “坏消息，团队。从海盗论坛上的传言来看，他们正在将这次袭击与我们联系起来。”\\n\\n杨将双臂交叉在胸前。 “可恶的人啊！铁胡子要退役了，这太不符合他的犯罪性格了。”

column1: Safely back on the Argo, Sumire watches the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} news feeds. "Looks like this particular pop-up shop is shut down. It's on all the networks. I give the cabal 24 hours before a new one opens, though."\\n\\nDarius is reading updates from less public information sources. "The pirate forums don't have much more information. Fortunately, no one is linking the raid back to us."\\n\\nYang crosses his arms over his chest. "Okay, okay, but Iron Beard doesn't feel good about playing both sides like this. It reflects poorly on his criminal character."
column2: 安全返回阿尔戈号后，堇观看了 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 新闻推送。 “看起来这个特定的快闪店被关闭了。它在所有网络上都有。不过，我给阴谋集团 24 小时时间，然后再开一家新店。”\\n\\nDarius 正在从不太公开的信息来源阅读更新。 “海盗论坛没有更多信息。幸运的是，没有人将这次袭击与我们联系起来。”\\n\\n杨双臂交叉在胸前。 “好吧好吧，但是铁胡子这样两边打的感觉不太好，这很不符合他的犯罪性格。”

column1: Sargeant Devin Chaste, callsign "Bugaboo", woke up one day in his barracks and realized he had grown weary of leading brash, young MechWarriors to their doom under the uncaring gaze of his commanding officer in the Steiner army. After finally receiving his discharge paperwork for a decorated career in service, he used his connections, along with his pension, to escape into mercenary life. Bugaboo has since proven himself a respectable addition to any mercenary company looking for a lance leader capable of coordinating tactical alpha strikes to the his employer's enemies.\\n\\n
column2: 德文·查斯特中士（呼号“Bugaboo”）有一天在军营中醒来，意识到自己已经厌倦了在施泰纳军队指挥官漠不关心的目光下带领傲慢的年轻机甲战士走向灭亡。在最终收到光荣服役生涯的退役文件后，他利用自己的关系和养老金，逃入了雇佣兵生活。自此，Bugaboo 证明了自己是任何雇佣兵公司中值得尊敬的新成员，他们正在寻找一位能够协调对雇主的敌人进行战术性阿尔法打击的长矛领袖。\\n\\n

column1: Sarge's incredible skill with this mech improves its damage reduction by 10%.
column2: 中士对这台机甲的令人难以置信的技能将其伤害减免提高了 10%。

column1: Sumire reports a call for help from a nearby ship. "It's another ship that's contracted the Periphery Pox ."\\n\\nDarius begins to speak, but Dr. Murad cuts him off. "I know what our XO will say." She continues in a perfect imitation of Darius, "We went to the trouble of developing this serum, let's make back some of that investment!"\\n\\nWith a smile, Darius plays along. "Speaking for our dear Dr. Murad, we've suffered from the Pox ourselves. Let's give away our serum, and maybe the locals will smile at us afterward."\\n\\nDr. Murad finishes with, "If we do sell the serum, I think we could easily get ¢80k."
column2: 堇报告附近一艘船只发出求救信号。 “这是另一艘感染了外围痘的船。”\\n\\nDarius 开始说话，但 Murad 博士打断了他。 “我知道我们的 XO 会说什么。”她完美地模仿了大流士，继续说道：“我们不辞辛劳地开发了这种血清，让我们收回一些投资吧！”\\n\\n大流士面带微笑，配合着。 “代表我们亲爱的 Murad 博士发言，我们自己也曾患过痘病。让我们捐出我们的血清，也许之后当地人会对我们微笑。”\\n\\nDr. Murad Murad 最后说道：“如果我们出售血清，我认为我们可以轻松获得 ￠80k。”

column1: Sumire takes the Leopard for a low altitude circuit of the moon, relaying her findings back to the Argo's computers. Over the course of the week she works with the collected data, then delivers her report.\\n\\n"Commander, the scientists I've been talking with are really excited about the data we've acquired. Apparently, it contains proof of a rare ore of scholastic interest." She shrugs. "Not my wheelhouse. In any case, I've negotiated an excellent price for the full scans, so everybody can celebrate."
column2: 堇带着 Leopard 进行了月球低空环游，将她的发现传回 Argo 的计算机。 在一周的时间里，她处理收集到的数据，然后提交报告。\\n\\n“指挥官，与我交谈的科学家们对我们获得的数据非常兴奋。显然，它包含了学术界感兴趣的稀有矿石的证据。”她耸耸肩。 “不是我的驾驶室。无论如何，我已经为全面扫描协商了一个优惠的价格，所以每个人都可以庆祝。”

column1: Sumire takes the Leopard for a low altitude circuit of the moon, relaying her findings back to the Argo's computers. Over the course of the week she works with the collected data, then delivers her report.\\n\\n"Commander, we aren't the only ones who were curious about this moon. I identified an abandoned facility, completely destroyed and then buried. Whoever it was, I wonder what they were doing."
column2: 堇带着 Leopard 进行了月球低空环游，将她的发现传回 Argo 的计算机。在这一周的时间里，她处理收集到的数据，然后提交报告。\\n\\n“指挥官，我们并不是唯一对这颗卫星感到好奇的人。我发现了一个废弃的设施，被完全摧毁，然后被掩埋。无论是谁，我想知道他们在做什么。”

column1: Sumire takes the Leopard for what is supposed to be no more than a low altitude fly-by of the ruins, though some of her photos seem suspiciously close to the ground. After the trip, she spends a week cataloging the collected data and then delivers her report.\\n\\n"Commander, look at this! See those shadows? And this indentation? That's an underground complex nobody's ever found before! And there's a symposium of historians willing to pay a mint to preempt the general release of our findings.\\n\\nYou whistle at the sum and say, "Are you leaving us to become an archaeologist now?"\\n\\nShe only grins at you before returning to her work.
column2: 堇拍摄的豹子本应只是低空飞越废墟，但她的一些照片看起来离地面很近，令人怀疑。旅行结束后，她花了一周的时间对收集到的数据进行编目，然后提交报告。\\n\\n“指挥官，看看这个！看到那些阴影了吗？还有这个凹痕？那是一个以前没有人发现过的地下建筑群！还有一个历史学家研讨会愿意花点钱抢先公布我们的发现。\\n\\n你看着这个数字，吹口哨说：“你要离开我们去当考古学家吗？现在？”\\n\\n她只是对你笑了笑，然后就继续工作了。

column1: Surrounded by the scent of growing things, you remember the laughter around the salad bar the night before. "Darius, I know you're trying to help us make ends meet here, but I don't want to go back to how things were."\\n\\nYou grab a berry from Darius's basket and pop it into your mouth. Delicious juice reinforces your decision. "Decline the trade. The morale of the crew is more important right now."
column2: 被植物的香气包围着，你还记得前一天晚上沙拉吧周围的笑声。 “Darius，我知道你想帮助我们维持收支平衡，但我不想回到原来的样子。”\\n\\n你从Darius的篮子里抓起一个浆果，然后把它放进嘴里。美味的果汁会强化您的决定。 “拒绝交易。现在船员的士气更重要。”

column1: 'Thank you for taking the Quicsell product demonstration tour! If you look over there, you'll see one of our most ambitious projects, the Speedy Leg total actuator replacement package! Why, look at how fast that mech can move! We've increased sprint speed by almost twenty percent, and' -CRASH- 'Oh dear. He's fallen over again. Um... If you will please quickly move along, I can show you the next product. Away from here.'
column2: “感谢各位参加快销公司的产品演示之旅! 请往那边看，那里是我们最具雄心的项目之一——迅捷腿部驱动器替换件! 哇，瞧瞧那台机甲跑得多快! 我们把冲刺速度提升了近二十个百分点，而且——哐当——哎呀. 它又摔倒了. 呃……请各位快速移步，我带你们看看下一款 产品. 离这儿远点.”

column1: The "south" direction of the known universe is called rimward. It's the direction that points away from the galaxy's center.
column2: 已知宇宙的“南”方向被称为缘向（Rimward）. 它是指向远离银河系中心的方向.

column1: The Angst Clear View 1A was 设计ed for the Solaris Market. Each Clear View 1A system had to be painstakingly calibrated to the Pilot's Neurohelm. Coupled with a movement prediction algorithm, it allowed the '机甲 to engage in lightning fast strikes without telegraphing the intent of the Pilot, closing the Enemies' dodging window by around half.
column2: 【FCS Berserker】Angst清晰视野1A型是为索拉里斯市场设计的. 每套清晰视野1A系统都必须经过精心校准，以匹配机师的神经头盔. 结合一套移动预测算法，它能使机甲发动闪电般的快速打击，而不会暴露机师的意图，将敌人的闪避窗口缩短了大约一半.

column1: The Ares Target Projection Suite steps above dedicated fire control systems and targeting computers by utilizing dozens of parallel computational systems and a series of laser-based sensory equipment to assess where a target is and to predict where it will be when the ballistic projectile would arrive on-target. While this affords a superior accuracy for pilots, the inability to override the FCS lock-out is controversial amongst many veteran pilots.
column2: 【Ares TPS Attachment】阿瑞斯目标投射套件超越了专用的火控系统和目标计算机，它利用数十个并行计算系统以及一系列基于激光的传感设备，来评估目标的位置，并预测弹道射弹抵达目标时目标会在哪里. 虽然这为机师提供了卓越的精度，但无法覆盖火控系统的锁定，这在许多资深机师中颇具争议.

column1: The barrel of this flamer has been crimped at the end, probably in some moronic attempt to make it shoot farther.  You'll be lucky if it doesn't just blow up in your face.
column2: 这具火焰喷射器的炮口被压扁了，大概是某个蠢货想让它射得更远. 它没在你脸上炸开就算你走运了.

column1: The blizzard increases heat sinking efficiency by 20%, and by an additional 12 heat per turn. In the snow, visibility and sensor efficiency is reduced to 60%, and all units have +2 Defense. Due to the the high winds, stability damage for land units is increased by 15%, movement cost for '机甲s and wheeled 载具s is increased by 20%, and VTOL units have -1 evasion.
column2: 暴风雪使散热效率提升 20%，且每回合额外降低 12 点热量. 在雪地中，能见度和传感器效率降至 60%，所有单位获得 +2 防御. 由于强风影响，地面单位的稳定性伤害增加 15%，机甲和轮式车辆的移动消耗增加 20%，垂直起降单位闪避 -1.

column1: The Bounty Hunter and his Associates have near-perfect Called Shots and deal [AMT] more damage with all attacks.
column2: 赏金猎人及其伙伴的精准射击近乎完美，并且所有攻击会多造成[AMT]伤害.

column1: The Bounty Hunter and his Associates have near-perfect Called Shots and deal 20% more damage with all attacks.
column2: 赏金猎人及其伙伴的精准射击近乎完美，并且所有攻击会多造成20%的伤害.

column1: The Bounty Hunter's attacks bypass 装甲 and deal structure damage to the target.
column2: 赏金猎人的攻击会无视装甲，对目标造成结构伤害.

column1: The Chameleon Light Polarization Shield was 设计ed to make a '机甲 invisible to the naked eye. By using a primitive mimetic system, the outline of the '机甲 carrying it was broken up, blending into the surrounding terrain. The Chameleon was very effective because unlike the Null Signature System it worked against sensor systems and visual observation.
column2: 变色龙偏振护盾旨在让装备它的机甲在人眼中隐形. 通过使用一种原始的拟态系统，它能够打乱机甲的轮廓，使其融入周围地形. 变色龙系统非常有效，因为不同于零特征系统，它不仅能够对抗传感器系统，也能干扰视觉观察.

column1: The Dagda system consists of an F9V class primary named "Tuath" orbited by eight worlds.
column2: Dagda星系由一颗名为“Tuath”的F9V级主星以及环绕其运行的八颗行星组成.

column1:
The Emergency Coolant System 开发 by the Republic Institute of Strategic Combat is a further advancement of the Radical Heat Sink System. It is intended to last longer by automatically activating whenever the Battle机甲 exceeds a certain heat level. The system overall worked, but it had a tendency to fail catastrophically, and potentially destroy the engine in the process. Fortunately, it was configured in such a way that it couldn't be activated manually, which helped reduce the negative consequences of overusing the system. This is the Superheavy, even further improved version of the system, which practically can not be removed from the chassis due to how heavily fused into the structure it is.

VOLATILE!.
column2: 紧急冷却系统由共和国战略战斗研究所开发，是激进散热系统的进一步升级. 它旨在通过每当战斗机甲超过一定热量水平时自动激活，来延长持续时间. 该系统总体有效，但存在灾难性故障的倾向，并可能在此过程中摧毁引擎. 幸运的是，其配置方式使其无法手动激活，这有助于减少过度使用该系统带来的负面影响. 这是超重型版本，是该系统的进一步改进型，由于其与结构高度融合，实际上无法从底盘上拆除. \\n\\n易爆!

column1: The Enhanced Imaging Display is a modular Heads-Up Display based on the Star League's Brain Wire program.[1] Forming part of the Clans' Enhanced Imaging system, the EI display is an advanced battle computer which simplifies the warrior's battlefield view with an enhanced virtual reality display. By combining sensor information from surrounding friendly units with preloaded terrain data, the EI display constructs a virtual view of the battlefield which clearly identifies all targets as friendly or hostile and allows technical data on a selected unit to be called up with a simple command. Besides removing the need to look down at cockpit controls and preventing the warrior from being overloaded with unnecessary data, the virtual display also presents a moveable perspective, allowing the warrior to change his point-of-view to observe any area of the battlefield from any angle.
column2: 增强成像显示器（EI Display）是一种模块化平视显示器，其技术源自星际联盟的“脑线”计划. [1] 作为氏族增强成像系统的一部分，EI显示器是一种先进的作战电脑，通过增强虚拟现实显示来简化战士的战场视野. 它将周围友方单位的传感器信息与预载的地形数据相结合，构建出一幅战场虚拟视图，能清晰地将所有目标识别为友方或敌方，并可通过简单指令调取所选单位的技术数据. 除了免去低头查看驾驶舱仪表的必要，并防止战士被无用数据淹没之外，这种虚拟显示还提供可移动的视角，使战士能够改变观察角度，从任意方向观察战场上的任何区域.

column1: The king of the battlefield, absolutely ruined by pirates. They've cut off half the barrel, made it hot-load two slugs at a time, and scratched obscenities all over it. They've basically turned this AC/20 into a sawed-off shotgun. VOLATILE!
column2: 战场上的王者，被海盗彻底毁了. 他们锯掉了半截炮管，让它能一次热装填两发弹丸，还在上面刻满了污言秽语. 他们基本上把这门AC/20改成了一把锯短了的霰弹枪. 易爆!

column1: The Mech generates +100% weapon heat for 2 turns. Does not stack.
column2: 机甲武器产生的热量 +100%，持续2回合. 效果不可叠加.

column1: The Mech's Movement is reduced by 50% for 2 turns. Does not stack.
column2: 机甲的移动力降低 50%，持续 2 回合. 效果不可叠加.

column1: The Mercury is a fast, well-armed scout and raider BattleMech, praised for its modular weapon system and balance of speed and protection. Initially exclusive to elite units, it nearly vanished after widespread factory destruction. Later, it was unexpectedly revived, with production restarted and updated variants extending its service for decades.
column2: 水星是一种高速、武装精良的侦察与突袭型战斗机甲，以其模块化武器系统以及速度与防护之间的平衡而备受赞誉. 最初仅配属精英部队，在工厂大面积被毁后几乎绝迹. 后来，它出人意料地得以复兴，生产线重启，并推出了多种改进型号，使其服役期延续了数十年.

column1: The Particle Recycler Module is an extra component that can be added to most types of IS or CE Particle Projector Cannons. The module captures excess energy and reuses it for follow-up shots; effectively, lowering weapon heat generation per shot.
column2: 【Particle Recycler Module】粒子回收模块是一种额外组件，可加装到大多数类型的内天体或氏族粒子加农炮上. 该模块捕获多余能量并将其用于后续射击; 实际上降低了每次射击的武器热量产生.

column1: The population of Borghese was self-sustaining, providing its own food crops and famed for its exotic fish export known as the "mermaid" fish. The planet's capital was named Houston, which was also its largest city.
column2: Borghese的人口自给自足，自行种植粮食作物，并因出口一种名为“美人鱼”的奇异鱼类而闻名. 该行星的首府名为休斯顿，同时也是其最大的城市.

column1: The pouring rain increases heat sinking by 12 per turn. Visibility and sensor efficiency is reduced to 70%, and all units have +3 Defense. Hurricane winds cause land units to take 30% more stability damage, hover units have their movement cost increased by 50%, VTOL units have -2 evasion, and the scatter radius of weapons is increased by 40%.
column2: 倾盆暴雨使每回合散热增加 12 点. 能见度与传感器效能降至 70%，所有单位获得 +3 防御. 飓风导致地面单位承受的稳定性伤害增加 30%，悬浮单位移动消耗增加 50%，垂直起降飞行器单位闪避 -2，武器散布半径扩大 40%.

column1: The Queen's supply of eggs, ready to hatch and eviscerate any enemy in their way.  Not to be used in omelets.
column2: 【Egg Clutch】女王储备的卵  随时可以孵化  并将挡在它们面前的任何敌人开膛破肚. 禁止用于制作煎蛋卷.

column1: The REDMIC, or REmote Delivery Magnetic Inhibitor Cannon, is a cutting edge experimental prototype weapon focused on delivering highly magnetically charged soft slugs onto enemy mechs. Upon impact the slug deforms and attaches itself to the target unit, causing their gyros to overload with resulting large stability issues. Developed by a former RISC team for the Scorpion Empire, the only currently known platform is specially modified Tercio Superheavy 'Mechs.
column2: REDMIC，即远程投送磁力抑阻加农炮，是一种尖端的实验性原型武器，专注于将高磁性软质弹丸发射到敌方机甲上. 命中时弹丸会变形并附着于目标单位，导致其陀螺仪过载，从而引发严重的稳定性问题. 该武器由前RISC团队为天蝎帝国研发，目前已知的唯一搭载平台是经过特殊改装的Tercio超重型机甲.

column1: This is a....huge tree trunk. But it seems the tree is either extremely dense or was petrified at some point of its life.
column2: 这是一棵……巨大的树干。但这棵树似乎要么极其茂密，要么在其生命的某个阶段被石化了。

column1: This is basically a C3 Master module, but it's been overcharged and reconfigured to hijack all C3 networks on the battlefield, replacing their targeting data with what appears to be continuous recordings of an Anti-Missile System firing. Oh, and the whole thing is packed inside a brick of plastic explosives, "for stability" if you believe the message scrawled on the bottom. Yeah. It's incredibly sophisticated; too bad it's also incredibly stupid.
column2: 这基本上是一个 C3 主模块，但它被过度充电并重新配置为劫持战场上的 all C3 网络，用反导弹系统发射的连续记录替换其目标数据。哦，整个东西都装在一块塑料炸药里，“为了稳定”，如果你相信底部潦草地写着的话。是的。它非常复杂；太糟糕了，这也非常愚蠢。

column1: This is obviously going to be a fight, so you get things started early by sucker punching the group's leader in the gut. Meanwhile, {TGT_MW.Callsign} slugs another thug in the gut. Then the rest charge, and you're quickly overwhelmed by sheer numbers. The fight is going poorly enough that when the local police arrive, you're relieved.\\n\\nThree hours later, you've paid a ¢100,000 fine, the medics are done treating {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s injuries, and you're both on your way back to the Argo. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}, "Sorry about that, Commander. I didn't think that the Syndicate was still looking for me."
column2: 显然这将是一场战斗，所以你可以通过猛击该组织领导者的腹部来尽早开始行动。与此同时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 猛击另一个暴徒的肠道。然后剩下的人就会发起进攻，你很快就会被庞大的数字淹没。战斗进展得很糟糕，当当地警察到达时，你松了口气。\\n\\n三个小时后，你支付了 100,000 英镑的罚款，医务人员完成了 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 伤势的治疗，你们俩都在返回 Argo 的路上。 {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}，“抱歉，指挥官，没想到辛迪加还在找我。”

column1: This is obviously going to be a fight, so you get things started early by sucker punching the thug sent after [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. Meanwhile, {TGT_MW.Callsign} slugs another thug in the gut. Then the rest charge, and everything devolves into a confusion of fists and arms and heavy boots.\\n\\nSome time later, you're swinging at someone's bloody face as he backs away, and you realize he's the last enemy left. {TGT_MW.Callsign} is bent over trying to catch {TGT_MW.DET} breath and the groups leader is gone, along with most of his gang. "Go on, get out of here!" you tell the last one. He turns and runs.\\n\\nYou offer {TGT_MW.Callsign} your hand. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}, "That was a good scrap, Commander. But we'd better go, too."
column2: 这显然会是一场战斗，所以你可以通过对 [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 之后派出的暴徒进行猛击来尽早开始行动。与此同时，{TGT_MW.Callsign} 猛击另一个暴徒的肠道。然后剩下的人发起冲锋，一切都变成了拳头、手臂和沉重靴子的混乱。\\n\\n过了一段时间，当某人后退时，你向他血淋淋的脸挥舞，你意识到他是最后一个敌人了。 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 弯下腰试图喘口气，但该组织的领导者和他的大部分团伙都消失了。 “走吧，离开这里！”你告诉最后一个。他转身就跑。\\n\\n你向 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 伸出你的手。 {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}：“指挥官，打得不错，不过我们也走吧。”

column1: This is terrible. A pirate finds pulse technology and in an effort to improve it, cracks open the focusing chamber and hot-wires the capacitors into a feedback loop. You've got to stop bringing me this crap.
column2: 【L. Pulse Laser (P)】这东西糟透了. 一个海盗弄到了脉冲技术，为了改进它，竟然把聚焦腔打开，还把电容器硬接成了反馈回路. 你别再把这种破烂东西拿给我了.

column1: This is the pride and joy of some Periphery pirate. While I'll freely admit the specifications for the fire rate and overall damage are impressive, it comes at the cost of accuracy and this impossible to source custom ammo. We can make the stuff, but supplies are always going to be tight.
column2: 这是一些外围海盗的骄傲和喜悦。虽然我坦率地承认射速和总体伤害的规格令人印象深刻，但它是以准确性为代价的，而且不可能采购定制弹药。我们可以制造这些东西，但供应总是会紧张。

column1: This marvel of engineering has been violated in so many ways. I cannot begin to decipher what its been through. And no, the fake magazine attached to its underside cannot be removed. It is somehow integrated into the containment field that keeps this thing from blowing up when fired. VOLATILE!
column2: 【ER PPC (P)】这件工程奇迹已经被以各种方式改造得面目全非. 我根本无法想象它到底经历了什么. 还有，不，安装在它底部的假弹匣无法拆除. 它不知为何已经整合进了约束场系统中，而这个系统正是防止这东西在开火时发生爆炸的关键. 易爆！

But due to the procedure, it has been linked directly into the engine core, making it impossible to be removed without risking either destroying the engine enclosure or the thruster, but its destruction won't affect the engine core itself due to the extra bulk and safeguards.
column2: 这种专门修改的定向推进器是针对特殊的 MAD-DER Marauder 变型而修改的，与 L.A.M. 配合使用。系统绑在机甲的底盘上，虽然不可能消除推进器的所有重量成本，但它比普通推进器更轻。但由于该过程，它已直接连接到发动机核心，因此不可能在不损坏发动机外壳或推进器的情况下将其移除，但由于额外的体积和防护措施，其破坏不会影响发动机核心本身。

column1: Though they do inflict damage directly on a target, what makes these munitions so effective is their secondary effects. The warheads blanket the target in electromagnetic noise, causing the target to move more slowly, overheat, and interfere with sensor systems.  Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
column2: 尽管它们确实会直接对目标造成伤害，但这些弹药之所以如此有效，是因为它们的次级效应。弹头在电磁噪声中覆盖目标，导致目标移动更慢、过热并干扰传感器系统。  受到致命一击后，弹药箱内储存的任何剩余弹药都会爆炸，对安装位置造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E 可以降低风险。

column1: Tor Vizsla is a Mandalorian warrior who was the first leader of the Death Watch, founding it after Jaster Mereel ascended to the rank of Mand'alor.\\n\\n
column2: 托尔·维兹拉是一名曼达洛战士，他是死亡守望者的第一任领导者，在贾斯特·梅里尔晋升曼达洛后创立了死亡守望者组织。\\n\\n

column1: Trex "Kamea" Arano was the daughter of Kamea Arano. Trex was often simply called Kamea the Second due to her near identical looks to her mother, so much so that historians have difficulty figuring out which holo-images to attribute to either one. \\n\\nBorn only a few years after her mother's victory over Santiago Espinosa's Directorate, Trex grew up watching as her people struggled in the post-wars years to rebuild and became determined to help her people no matter the cost.\\n\\nTrex ascended to the throne at the age of 19 when her mother decided that she had ruled long enough and stepped down as High Lady of the Reach. Like her mother before her, Trex proved a natural leader, and she was able to inspire her people to not only make the Aurigan Reach prosperous for a Periphery state, but to successfully defend it and even launch a counteroffensive against the Capellan Confederation. It is said that Trex herself planned and led the campaign that seized chancellor Slippy's personal salt mine and drove him insane.\\n\\nAfter the war, Trex returned her focus on making her nation the best that it could be before handing down the throne to a new generation of leadership like her mother before her - setting a tradition within the Reach of voluntarily giving up power before old age and world-weariness caught up with the High Lord/Lady.\\n
column2: 特雷克斯·“卡米亚”·阿拉诺是卡米亚·阿拉诺的女儿。特雷克斯经常被简单地称为卡米亚二世，因为她的长相与她的母亲几乎一模一样，以至于历史学家很难弄清楚哪些全息图像应该归属于其中任何一个。 \\n\\n在她母亲战胜圣地亚哥·埃斯皮诺萨的理事会几年后出生，特雷克斯看着她的人民在战后的岁月中为重建而奋斗，并决心不惜一切代价帮助她的人民。\\n\\n特雷克斯在 19 岁时登上王位，当时她的母亲认为她已经统治了足够长的时间，并辞去了河湾高级女士的职务。就像她的母亲一样，特雷克斯证明了自己是一位天生的领导者，她不仅能够激励她的人民使阿里根河区成为外围国家的繁荣，而且能够成功保卫它，甚至对卡佩伦联邦发起反攻。据说，特雷克斯亲自策划并领导了一场夺取财政大臣斯利皮私人盐矿并把他逼疯的运动。\\n\\n战后，特雷克斯将注意力集中在让她的国家尽可能成为最好的国家，然后将王位交给像她母亲那样的新一代领导层 - 在高领主/女士年老和厌世之前，在范围内树立了自愿放弃权力的传统。\\n

column1: You shake your head. "I'm sorry, Sumire. We simply can't spare any MechWarriors right now. They'll just need to adjust to the pace of things here, and work on their own ways to improve morale."
column2: 你摇了摇头.“抱歉，苏米尔. 我们现在实在抽不出机甲战士. 他们只能自己适应这儿的节奏了，另外想辙提升士气吧.”

column1: You shake your head. "No, Doctor. As much as it pains me to see them in the MedBay, I know that they're in good hands. And we should be able to get along fine until they're on the mend. Let's save your grand experiment for when we're in truly desperate straits."
column2: 你摇了摇头.“不，博士. 虽说看着他们躺在医务室里让我很不好受，但我知道他们得到了很好的照料. 而且在他们痊愈之前，我们应该也能应付得来. 还是把你那宏大的实验留到真正山穷水尽的时候吧.”

column1: You shake your head. "Not this time, Yang. Unfortunately, we can't spare the resources, despite the AgroMechs." Yang sighs. He lets the argument drop, but spends a few days wistfully looking at Technical Readouts with his crew.
column2: 你摇了摇头.“这次不行，杨. 虽然那些农业机甲挺诱人的，但我们眼下实在腾不出资源.”杨叹了口气. 他没再争辩，但接下来好几天，他总跟手下的技术员们一起翻着各种技术参数图册，眼神里全是心驰神往.

column1: Introduced in the late 31st Century on Solaris VII, the Combat Shield is a movable piece of armor that can be mounted on BattleMechs. The shield was first introduced as a method to add protection for a MechWarrior fighting in the arenas of Solaris. Shields are primary defensive equipment used to protect a 'Mech from Weapons fire and some forms of physical attacks. Equipping more than 1 wont yield additional effects, does not stack with other combat shields.
column2: 战斗护盾于31世纪晚期在索拉里斯七号首次出现，是一种可安装在战斗机甲上的可动式装甲组件. 该护盾最初是为了在索拉里斯竞技场中为机甲战士增添防护而引入的. 护盾属于主要防御装备，用于保护机甲免受武器射击以及某些形式的物理攻击. 装备超过一面不会产生额外效果，也不与其他战斗护盾叠加.
