column1: You turn back to Darius shaking your head,  "That MechWarrior failed the Trial, as well as ended up in the infirmary.  I have no need of one such as them within our ranks."
column2: 你转头向达吕斯摇了摇头:“那名机甲战士输掉了试炼，还进了医务室. 我的队伍中不需要这样的人.”

column1: Odin Manufacturing built this for former KungsArmé soldiers after they got folded into the Ghost Bear Dominion. Those veterans wanted something that fit how they fought and the Dengier delivered. Ten official variants by 3155, which tells you how well the base chassis worked. Ghost Bear warriors eventually started using it too, which is about as good an endorsement as you can get.
column2: 奥丁制造公司为前 KungsArmé 士兵在加入鬼熊领地后建造了这个。那些退伍军人想要一些适合他们战斗方式的东西，而丹吉尔交付了。 3155 的十个官方变体，告诉您基础底盘的工作情况如何。鬼熊战士最终也开始使用它，这几乎是你能得到的最好的认可。

column1: Startled by Darius' question, you take a minute before responding, "Sorry, I was doing the budget in my head.  Have Farah and her team begin the repairs on the console."\\nDarius turns to the computer to type up the work order, "On to it, Commander."
column2: 你被达里厄斯的问题吓了一跳，过了一会儿才回答，“抱歉，我正在脑子里做预算。让法拉赫和她的团队开始在控制台上进行维修。”\\n达里厄斯转向电脑输入工单，“开始吧，指挥官。”

column1: A Jihad-era variant, this Hitman drops all the standard armament and gyroscope. In their place engineers installed an XL Gyro, MML-7, and dual ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 这是一款圣战时代的杀手变体，舍弃所有标准武装和陀螺仪，改装XL陀螺仪、MML-7和双联ER中型激光器。

column1: Boss... This mech is based on Seraph, however version is fully packed with experimental technologies. I don't know where you got it, but I smell troubles.
column2: 老板……这台机甲基于炽天使，但该版本充满实验技术。我不知道你从哪弄来的，不过我感觉麻烦不小。

column1: Crab 27s fulfill an oft overlooked role, that of a skirmisher with firepower. Wielding strong energy weapons, the Crab delivers a punch at nearly all ranges, with no ammunition constraints. The blend of firepower, heat efficiency, and speed make the Crab the perfect '机甲 to raid enemy positions.
column2: “螃蟹 27”机甲扮演着一个经常被低估的角色: 一个拥有大量火力的散兵.“螃蟹”拥有强大的能量武器，它几乎可以在任何距离发挥作用而不依赖于弹药. 火力、热效率和速度的结合使“螃蟹”成为了突袭敌人阵地的完美机甲.

column1: Cyclops 10-Qs are strong support units. Lacking the close in weapons and command suite of the 10-Z variant, this model instead capitalizes on a longer range weapon configuration and added 装甲. The protection and expanded missile racks make the 10-Q a significant threat at range in the right hands.
column2: “独眼巨人 10-Q”机甲是强大的支援单位. 它可能没有10-Z变体那样的短程武器，但该模型具有强大的远程武器和额外的装甲. 增强的保护和扩展的导弹发射架使10-Q成为了真正的威胁.

column1: Micheal Coleman, a Periphery Militia Captain, was able to beat a Clanner in a Batchall and Won this Jaguar out of it. Looking at the Mech, and at the Available Resources, he Created this. On first Looks, the Mech itself seems very Archaic, yet it Still Works. Coleman Reportedly Blasted Multiple Enemies to Pieces in this Jaguar, untill one day the Knockback from the Howitzers Proved too much, Knocked the Mech over and Hurt Coleman Fatally.
column2: 外围民兵队长迈克尔·科尔曼 (Micheal Coleman) 在一场批量比赛中击败了一名部落成员，并赢得了这辆美洲虎。看着机甲和可用资源，他创造了这个。乍一看，机甲本身看起来非常古老，但它仍然有效。据报道，科尔曼驾驶这辆美洲虎将多个敌人炸成碎片，直到有一天，榴弹炮的击退效果实在太严重，将机甲撞翻，科尔曼身受重伤。

column1: More closely in line with the traditional Annihilator, the 4A carried two LB-X Autocannon/10s from the 2A, but removed two to make room for a pair of Heavy PPCs. Two Light Autocannon/2s from the 3A provide defense against conventional troops. A Compact Gyro freed up enough room for fifteen double heat sinks that kept heat from being completely out of control.
column2: 与传统的歼灭者更接近的是，4A 从 2A 上携带了两架 LB-X Autocannon/10s，但去掉了两架，以便为一对重型 PPC 腾出空间。 3A 中的两架轻型 Autocannon/2s 提供对常规部队的防御。紧凑型陀螺仪为十五个双散热器腾出了足够的空间，防止热量完全失控。

column1: More flexible than the 3S at the cost of more wasteful ammunition usage, but the longer strike distance makes it a better variant.
column2: 比 3S 更灵活，但弹药使用更浪费，但更长的打击距离使其成为更好的变体。

column1: More of a 'what was on hand' refit of a SLDF-era Mech, this Steel Viper unit was made as a last hope reinforcement that never saw the light of day. Equipped with Clan spec gear and pre-Clan weaponry, it is a hodge podge of technology that would be a nightmare to keep working. Even in the Inner Sphere, this thing would be a rarity to encounter.
column2: 这台钢蝰蛇装置更像是对 SLDF 时代机甲的“现有”改装，它是作为最后希望的加固而制造的，但从未见过世面。它配备了部落规格的装备和部落前的武器，这是一个技术大杂烩，继续工作将是一场噩梦。即使在内天界，这种东西也很少见。

column1: Mostly a Museum piece was this Shadow Hawk rebuild on request for a Paladins 'Special Associate', sporting upgrades sourced from basically everywhere is it able to strike unseen basically anywhere at anytime even during Planet wide Engagements.
column2: 主要是博物馆的一件作品，是根据圣骑士“特别助理”的要求重建的暗影鹰，其运动升级基本上来自任何地方，即使在全球范围内的交战中，它也能够基本上随时随地进行看不见的攻击。

column1: Named after a mythological Pirate from pre-spaceflight Terra, this one has been given extensive upgrades in every direction. A heavier Hatchet lets this refit cleave 'Mechs of the same weight class apart with ease. Stealth armor makes it hard to detect while it's closing in, and the 330-rated engine makes sure it doesn't take long. Five Medium Lasers and a SRM6 see to it that it's also a dangerous brawler for its weight class. Fifteen Double Heat Sinks ensure this Buccaneer won't die of heatstroke out in the sun - or of a trigger happy mech-jock.
column2: 这艘船以太空飞行前的泰拉神话中的海盗命名，在各个方面都进行了广泛的升级。较重的斧头让这款改装可以轻松地将相同重量级别的机甲分开。隐形装甲使其在接近时难以被发现，而 330 级发动机确保它不会花费很长时间。五个中型激光器和一个 SRM6 使其在重量级别上也是一个危险的争斗者。十五个双散热器确保这款海盗不会在阳光下因中暑而死亡，也不会因快乐的机甲运动员而死亡。

column1: Named after a stealth fighter, and it's easily the best armed of the whole Shattered Skies line. Every weapon system on it was top shelf for the era, Artemis IV, Streak SRMs, pulse lasers, the works. Heaviest of the four too at 55 tons. Same story as its siblings in the end though, chewed up by the civil war and gone from almost every army by 2850.
column2: 以隐形战斗机命名，它无疑是整个破碎天空系列中武装最好的。其上的每一个武器系统都是那个时代的顶级武器系统，Artemis IV、Streak SRM、脉冲激光器等等。四者中最重的也是 55 吨。不过，最终的故事和它的兄弟姐妹一样，都受到内战的摧残，到 2850 年几乎从每支军队中消失。

column1: Named for some supposedly ancient Warrior of Terran mythology does this experimental No-Dachi carry a reforged Large Vibroblade and is equipped with advanced Myomer.
column2: 这款实验性的 No-Dachi 以一些所谓的古代人类神话战士的名字命名，它携带着重铸的大型振动刀，并配备了先进的 Myomer。

column1: Named for the legendary spy plane, and it lived up to that reputation with a Guardian ECM fit for staying hidden. Heavier than the Voodoo but still built around scouting first, fighting second. Same fate as the rest of the project though, nearly wiped out in the civil war and mostly gone by 2850.
column2: 以传奇的间谍飞机命名，它凭借适合隐藏的 Guardian ECM 名副其实。比 Voodoo 重，但仍然以侦察为先，战斗为其次。不过，与该项目其余部分的命运相同，在内战中几乎被消灭，到 2850 年大部分都消失了。

column1: Never seen this model of Goliath before, Boss - must be some mercenary unit's custom job. Not that we'd know anything about that, am I right?
column2: 以前从来没有见过这个模型的歌利亚，Boss——肯定是某个雇佣兵部队的定制工作。并不是说我们对此一无所知，对吗？

column1: Nightstars are normally pretty scary but this version might take the cake. That Hyper PPC will rip of tons of armor at a time while the Flechettes tear into everything beneath.
column2: 夜星通常非常可怕，但这个版本可能更胜一筹。 Hyper PPC 会一次撕裂成吨的装甲，而箭弹会撕裂下面的一切。

column1: Nimakachi built this one specifically for the Draconis Combine as a security mech. Saw a lot of use keeping Rasalhague worlds in line before they got their independence. Has a real ugly reputation honestly. The Fluid Gun was supposed to be non-lethal but that's not really how it played out in practice. Fell out of favor after the Clan Invasion when actual BattleMechs started costing the same. Production came back during the Jihad when parts got scarce.
column2: Nimakachi 专门为 Draconis 联合体建造了这个作为安全机甲。在拉萨尔哈格世界获得独立之前，我们看到了很多让它们保持一致的用途。老实说，名声确实很丑陋。流体枪本来应该是非致命性的，但实际上却并非如此。在氏族入侵之后，当实际的 BattleMech 开始花费相同的价格时，它就失宠了。圣战期间，零件短缺，生产恢复了。

column1: No surprise pirates got their Hands on a Trashcan, it is a surprise how they managed to 'repair' the mangled and broken Autocannon and welded 2 RocketLauncher onto the poor thing.
column2: 毫不奇怪，海盗们拿到了一个垃圾桶，令人惊讶的是他们如何设法“修复”受损和破损的自动加农炮，并将 2 个火箭发射器焊接到这个可怜的东西上。

column1: No. This is a bad idea. I don't care how cool it would be to see this thing flying in from above and planting those two harpoons into something. See that little sticker there? It says that the Mech will explode if I don't feed it. Feed it what? I don't know, they scratched that bit off.
column2: 不，这是一个坏主意。我不在乎看到这个东西从上面飞来并将那两个鱼叉插入某个东西会有多酷。看到那里的小贴纸了吗？它说如果我不给它喂食，机甲就会爆炸。喂它什么？我不知道，他们把那一点刮掉了。

column1: Nope, I can't agree with this refit. It is a clear downgrade, the ability to use different ammunition types does not make up for the loss of the Ultra.
column2: 不，我不能同意这次改装。这是明显的降级，使用不同弹药类型的能力并不能弥补Ultra的损失。

column1: Normally I'd say that the Royal BattleMaster is about as quintessential a BattleMech as you'll ever see. Guess the Clans didn't see it that way and felt they could improve on it. Well ... they tried, I suppose. This thing'd run hot as hell if not for all this extra gear, but I suppose they were limited on space, too. This baby is crammed to the gills.
column2: 通常我会说皇家战斗大师是您所见过的最典型的战斗机甲。我想族群并不这么认为，并认为他们可以改进。嗯……我想他们尝试过。如果没有这些额外的装备，这东西会热得要命，但我想它们的空间也有限。这个宝贝是crammed到腮帮子的。

column1: Not Much is known about this Mech, It handles just like a Normal Ostscout. The Engine has been Upgraded, and it was up Armoured. According to the Onboard Logs, the Targeting System for the Laser is Advanced, but i cant see anything Special about it. Maybe it gets better if a Certain person Pilots it?
column2: 关于这个机甲我们知之甚少，它的操作方式就像普通的东侦察兵一样。发动机已升级，并且已加装装甲。根据机载日志，激光瞄准系统很先进，但我看不出有什么特别之处。如果由某个人来驾驶的话，也许情况会更好？

column1: Not often you find one of these, Boss; this is a custom job, for sure. None of the Pulverizers I've ever heard of ran a full compliment of this kind of weaponry. She pales in comparison to what the Clans field today, but back in her day I bet she was a force to be reckoned with.
column2: 老板，你很少能找到这样的人；当然，这是一项定制工作。我听说过的粉碎机都没有对这种武器进行充分的赞美。与今天的族群相比，她相形见绌，但在她那个时代，我敢打赌她是一股不可忽视的力量。

column1: Not really that useful for us, this 'Mech is all about those LMGs.
column2: 对我们来说并不是那么有用，这个机甲就是那些轻机枪。

column1: Not sure what the purpose is here. Combining a single Clan tech level weapon with two machine guns doesn't make the most impressive variant, even if it has good speed.
column2: 不确定这里的目的是什么。将单一氏族科技级武器与两挺机枪结合起来并不能产生最令人印象深刻的变体，即使它具有良好的速度。

column1: Not sure why anybody'd go to the trouble of redesigning a chassis as old as this, but I guess profit is profit for somebody. The -03 carries a pair of MML-7 launchers and an ER Large Laser, so it can put the hurt on at any range you want.
column2: 不知道为什么有人会不厌其烦地重新设计这么老的底盘，但我想利润对某些人来说就是利润。 -03 携带一对 MML-7 发射器和一个 ER 大型激光器，因此它可以在您想要的任何范围内造成伤害。

column1: Nothing really makes this variant different from other recent Wolverines. That Heavy PPC does suffer a bit from shorter range, but overall the 'Mech does just fine on the battlefield.
column2: 这个变种与其他最近的狼獾没什么区别。重型 PPC 确实因射程较短而受到一些影响，但总的来说，“机甲”在战场上表现得很好。

column1: Now this I can work with, boss. No finicky pulse lasers or high tech missile launchers to babysit, just honest guns even a Periphery wrench-turner can keep running. Cheap, tough, and it still hides behind that big shield. VEST knew their market.
column2: 现在我可以合作了，老板。没有挑剔的脉冲激光器或高科技导弹发射器来照顾，只有诚实的枪支，即使是外围扳手也可以继续运行。便宜、坚固，而且它仍然隐藏在那个大盾牌后面。 VEST 了解他们的市场。

column1: Now this is a proper upgrade. The original Penetrator suffered from heat issues that prevented it to reach a good level of damage over long engagements. More heat sinks, a battle computer and some longer weaponry will make some good differences.
column2: 现在这是一次适当的升级。最初的穿甲弹遭遇过热问题，导致其在长时间交战中无法达到良好的伤害水平。更多的散热器、战斗计算机和一些更长的武器将会带来一些好的变化。

column1: Now this is pretty much a thing of nightmares, a stealthy Jinggau with advanced ECM and sensors. It'd be always stalking, but whenever you look behind you, it can not be seen!
column2: 现在这几乎是一场噩梦，一个拥有先进 ECM 和传感器的隐形 Jinggau。它总是在跟踪，但每当你回头看时，它就看不见了！

column1: Now this is what i call a Engineer's dream, fully upgraded Void Mimetic Systems, Command and Control System able to guide a whole company, the finest Electronics available and its all coming pretending to be just a old Longbow
column2: 现在，这就是我所说的工程师的梦想，完全升级的虚空拟态系统，能够指导整个连队的命令和控制系统，可用的最好的电子设备，而这一切都假装是一把旧的长弓

column1: Now would'ya look at this, this thing must have been kept alive and be loved for Hundreds of Years, It 'is' a Mackie, but they managed to cram Endo Steel and more modern tech into it, every piece shows signs of being repaired dozens if not hundreds of times. Theres also a '<3 Nature' sticker on the Engine!
column2: 现在你看看这个，这个东西肯定已经被保存并被人们喜爱了数百年，它“是”麦基，但他们设法将远藤钢和更现代的技术塞进里面，每件作品都显示出被修复了数十次甚至数百次的迹象。引擎上还有一个“<3 Nature”贴纸！

column1: Old is the new new? Wolverines have been around for ages and with the continued refreshes it seems like they will not go away anytime soon.
column2: 旧的就是新的吗？狼獾已经存在很多年了，随着不断的更新，它们似乎不会很快消失。

column1: On one hand, that PPC is putting a lot of eggs into a particular basket but, on the other hand, that is one helluva big PPC.
column2: 一方面，PPC 将很多鸡蛋放入特定的篮子中，但另一方面，这是一个巨大的 PPC。

column1: Once again it is proven that the best 'Mechs are created on the battlefield, not in the design lab. These changes are much more to my liking than the -6M variant.
column2: 事实再次证明，最好的机甲是在战场上制造的，而不是在设计实验室中制造的。这些更改比 -6M 变体更符合我的喜好。

column1: Once the Republic Institute of Strategic Combat found out about the Urbiestator, they immediately acquired a number of them and created the UMS-R9999 experimental variant. Even though filled with a lot of the cutting edge technology, such as Superheavy Ferro-Alloy Armor, the design was never seen as of any real value due to its huge issues with heat management, but the existing copies can still be found on the battlefield.
column2: 共和国战略作战研究所发现Urbiestator后，立即购买了一批并创建了UMS-R9999实验变体。尽管充满了许多尖端技术，例如超重型铁合金装甲，但由于其热管理方面的巨大问题，该设计从未被视为具有任何实际价值，但现有的副本仍然可以在战场上找到。

column1: One hell of a speed beast, with some decent weapons.
column2: 一只速度猛兽，拥有一些像样的武器。

column1: One of only 50 of its kind, this 'Mech is supposedly a large improvement over the earlier variants. At least if you ask the Duke that designed it. Personally, I say it as good or bad as any other Bandersnatch.
column2: 这种机甲是仅有的 50 架同类机甲之一，据说比早期的变种有了很大的改进。至少如果你问设计它的公爵的话。就我个人而言，我认为它与其他《潘达斯奈基》一样好或坏。

column1: One of the best first generation ProtoMechs, the Centaur combines high speed, decent armor, and a varied weapons mix. These features make it a flexible combatant, able to keep up with scout 'Mechs while supporting them. Centaur 3 drops all weapons and a considerable amount of armor for a single ER Medium Laser.
column2: 半人马是最好的第一代原型机甲之一，它结合了高速、体面的装甲和多样化的武器组合。这些功能使其成为灵活的战斗人员，能够在支持侦察机甲的同时跟上它们。 Centaur 3 会为单个 ER 中型激光器掉落所有武器和大量装甲。

column1: One of the best first generation ProtoMechs, the Centaur combines high speed, decent armor, and a varied weapons mix. These features make it a flexible combatant, able to keep up with scout 'Mechs while supporting them. Developed during the 3060s, this variant utilizes then-newly developed Heavy Laser technology.
column2: 半人马是最好的第一代原型机甲之一，它结合了高速、体面的装甲和多样化的武器组合。这些功能使其成为灵活的战斗人员，能够在支持侦察机甲的同时跟上它们。该变体是在 3060s 期间开发的，采用了当时新开发的重型激光技术。

column1: One of the best known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere for its low production and operation costs, the Locust is also well known in the Clans. In 2832, Clan Mongoose unleashed an upgraded version of the venerable 'Mech on the Clans, known as the Locust IIC. The Z variant  is a Society refit that replaces the engine with a 200SL engine and replaces the weapons payload with 6 Small Supra Lasers and a Nova CEWS.
column2: 蝗虫因其低廉的生产和运营成本而成为内层界最知名的战机之一，在氏族中也广为人知。 2832 年，猫鼬氏族释放了古老的氏族机甲的升级版，称为蝗虫 IIC。 Z 变体是协会改装的，将发动机替换为 200SL 发动机，并将武器有效载荷替换为 6 个小型 Supra 激光器和一个 Nova CEWS。

column1: Pretty boring mech to be honest. Other than their knock-off stealth system, it's just a bog standard LRM40 boat crammed into a 30 ton mech. Due to weight limitations for the ammo, it'll struggle with extended engagements.
column2: 老实说，相当无聊的机械。除了他们的山寨隐形系统之外，它只是一艘塞进 30 吨机械的沼泽标准 LRM40 船。由于弹药的重量限制，它很难适应长时间的交战。

column1: Pretty rare build you've found here, Boss. Judging by the serial number on some of these parts, only a handful of these things were made. Not surprised, honestly. Back then, some of these parts were expensive as hell. That and the whole Star League exploding thing.
column2: 老板，你在这里找到的建筑相当罕见。从其中一些零件的序列号来看，这些东西只生产了极少数。老实说，并不感到惊讶。当时，其中一些零件非常昂贵。那和整个星际联盟的爆炸事件。

column1: Produced by Cosara Weaponries for the Word of Blake following their capture of the facility in 3069, the 008 uses the latest technologies available at the time. The autocannons have been upgraded to Heavy PPCs. The powerful weapons are backed up by paired Light Autocannon/2s, sharing one-ton of ammo in CASE-protected ammunition bin. Two ER Medium Lasers back up these guns. Like other Blakist units, a C3i Computer is included.A Guardian ECM Suite is also included. With seventeen double heat sinks and Jump Jets, this unit can jump and fire both of its main guns even with some heat to spare. Luckily this variant can be visually distinguished from others based on its more streamlined chassis, giving opponents some measure of warning.
column2: 008 是由 Cosara Weaponries 在 3069 年占领该设施后为布莱克之言生产的，采用了当时最新的技术。自动加农炮已升级为重型 PPC。这些强大的武器由成对的 Light Autocannon/2s 提供支持，在受 CASE 保护的弹药箱中共享一吨弹药。两台 ER 中型激光器为这些枪提供支持。与其他 Blakist 装置一样，还包括 C3i 计算机。还包括 Guardian ECM 套件。凭借十七个双散热器和跳跃喷气机，该装置可以跳跃并发射其两门主炮，即使有一些余热。幸运的是，由于其更流线型的底盘，该变体可以在视觉上与其他变体区分开来，从而给对手一定程度的警告。

column1: Produced during the Jihad, this configuration employs pair of ER Medium Lasers in left torso, while fitting pair of Light PPCs in each arm actuator slot.
column2: 该配置是在圣战期间生产的，在左躯干中采用了一对 ER 中型激光器，同时在每个手臂致动器插槽中安装了一对轻型 PPC。

column1: Produced in secret by 'The Society', an organization of Rogue Scientists within the Clans, this prototype testbed Griffin carries advanced Technology and weapons.
column2: 这个格里芬原型测试台由部落内的流氓科学家组织“协会”秘密生产，携带着先进的技术和武器。

column1: Produced in the last years of the Amaris Civil War for the SLDF, the Thunder Hawk emphasizes firepower over speed. A 100-ton mech, the Thunder Hawk TDK-7S is built around a 300-rated Light Engine and is armed with a trio of Gauss Rifles, with a pair of Medium Lasers as back up weapons.
column2: 雷霆鹰是在阿马里斯内战最后几年为 SLDF 生产的，它强调火力而不是速度。雷霆鹰 TDK-7S 是一款重达 100 吨的机甲，围绕 300 级光引擎打造，配备三把高斯步枪，以及一对中型激光器作为备用武器。

column1: Renewing the Mad Cat legend, the Mk IV used some of the most powerful configurations of its grand brother, while also incorporating easier to find and replace components. Clan Sea Fox expected to experience the same success with this model, as it had with previous ones. This specific variant was a prototype non-Omni stolen by Clan Jade Falcon.
column2: Mk IV 延续了 Mad Cat 的传奇，使用了其祖父的一些最强大的配置，同时还融入了更易于查找和更换的组件。海狐氏族希望通过该模型获得与之前模型相同的成功。这个特定变体是翡翠隼氏族偷来的非 Omni 原型。

column1: Riley Centrella built this herself in 3060, the first upgrade she ever worked on before Firefly Foundry even existed. Stripped the Hammerhands down and replaced everything. Twin Ultra AC/10s, Streak SRM 6, ER lasers, double heat sinks. She piloted it through operations on Carmichael, Palm and Novo Tressida until 3079 when Word of Blake's Shadow Division finally cornered her on Ur Cruinne. She lured them into an oil refinery and took them all out with her. This mech went with her. What you have in the bay is something that should not exist.
column2: Riley Centrella 在 3060 年亲自建造了这个，这是她在 Firefly Foundry 存在之前进行的第一次升级。拆除了锤手并更换了一切。 Twin Ultra AC/10s、Streak SRM 6、ER 激光器，双散热器。她在卡迈克尔、帕姆和新特雷西达的行动中驾驶着它，直到 3079 年，布莱克的影子部队的消息最终将她逼到了乌尔克鲁因。她将他们引诱到炼油厂，并将他们全部带了出去。这台机甲跟她一起去了。你在海湾里拥有的东西是不应该存在的。

column1: Riley's Rangers, Magistracy-affiliated mercenaries, built this one themselves out of Firefly Foundry before they had proper facilities, which tells you something about how much the Blackjack meant to them. The BJ-1 bones are all still there but everything worth keeping got upgraded. LB-Xs instead of the old AC/2s, ER lasers, double heat sinks. It's a labor of love as much as a fighting machine. Rangers flew this thing with pride and honestly, looking at it, I get why.
column2: 莱利的游骑兵是隶属于治安官的雇佣兵，他们在拥有适当的设施之前就在萤火虫铸造厂中自己建造了这个，这告诉你二十一点对他们来说有多么重要。 BJ-1 骨头仍然存在，但所有值得保留的东西都已升级。 LB-Xs 代替旧的 AC/2s、ER 激光器，双散热器。这是一种爱的劳动，就像一架战斗机一样。流浪者队自豪地驾驶着这架飞机，老实说，看着它，我明白为什么。

column1: RISC engineers have turned this model into a close range brawling specialist mounting a Snubnose PPC in each arm along with a massive Rotary AC/20 Autocannon. Mobility is enhanced by the inclusion of three improved jump jets.
column2: RISC 工程师将该模型变成了近距离格斗专家，在每只手臂上安装了 Snubnose PPC 以及大型旋转 AC/20 自动炮。三个改进的跳跃喷气机增强了机动性。

column1: RISC engineers, deciding that the standard version of the Uziel just didn't shout loud enough, went to their glass drawing boards and completely reimagined the beast.  Now equipped with a pair of Light PPCs in the arms, and a total of 30 launch tubes of their now (in)famous MMLs, the UZL-RX was considered to be a premier skirmisher with it's capabilities to provide hell on earth at both short and long ranges.
column2: RISC 工程师认为 Uziel 的标准版本不够大声，于是他们走到玻璃绘图板上，完全重新想象了这头野兽。  现在，UZL-RX 的手臂上配备了一对轻型 PPC，以及总共 30 个现在（臭名昭著）的 MML 发射管，UZL-RX 被认为是顶级的散兵，具有在短距离和长距离提供人间地狱的能力。

column1: Rockets, rockets and more rockets. So many rockets that no sane person could need more.
column2: 火箭，火箭，还有更多的火箭。如此多的火箭，任何理智的人都不需要更多。

column1: Rotary AC/5, Streak SRM-6 and a Medium X-Pulse Laser. That is some nice tech for a Wolverine.
column2: 旋转 AC/5、Streak SRM-6 和中型 X 脉冲激光器。对于金刚狼来说，这是一些不错的技术。

column1: Seemingly raided from the DCMS was this mauler refit to accomodate a load of Jury Rigged Artillery.
column2: 这辆重锤改装车似乎是从 DCMS 上突袭而来，可容纳大量临时装备火炮。

column1: Seriously boss, I pity anything this thing targets when it's carrying it's full weapons load. There's 180 rocket tubes on this mech in addition to the PPCs and Lasers.
column2: 说实话，老大，当这东西满载武器时，我很同情它所瞄准的任何目标。除了 PPC 和激光器之外，该机甲上还有 180 个火箭管。

column1: Similar in some respects to the Dominus, the Infernus also mounts a Heavy PPC in the arm, but the other arm contains two Light PPCs. The weight saved allows the Archangel B to carry two Snub-Nose PPCs.
column2: 在某些方面与 Dominus 类似，Infernus 还在手臂上安装了重型 PPC，但另一只手臂包含两个轻型 PPC。减轻的重量使得大天使 B 能够携带两个塌鼻子 PPC。

column1: Similar to the -12K, it is a clear upgrade over the earlier variants. Find a good scenario for it and its performance might surprise you.
column2: 与 -12K 类似，它是对早期变体的明显升级。为它找到一个好的场景，它的表现可能会让你大吃一惊。

column1: Similar to the 5M2, this variant works as a very efficient scout.
column2: 与 5M2 类似，该型号是一种非常高效的侦察机。

column1: Similar to the B variant, the G uses five ER Medium Lasers and a HAG 20.
column2: 与 B 型号类似，G 使用五个 ER 中型激光器和一个 HAG 20。

column1: Similar to the original Thor's Prime Configuration, this arrangement of weaponry comes with of pair of side-torso LRM Launchers; large 15-tubed and a smaller 5-tubed model. Found in the Configuration's arms is a LB 10-X Class Autocannon and Extended Range Particle Projection Cannon, found in left and right arm actuators respectively. Also equipped in the Configuration is Five Jump Jets for tactical mobility.
column2: 与原来的雷神 Prime 配置类似，这种武器装备配有一对侧躯干 LRM 发射器；大型 15 管型号和较小的 5 管型号。该配置的手臂中装有 LB 10-X 级自动炮和增程粒子投射炮，分别位于左臂和右臂执行器中。配置中还配备了五架跳跃式喷气机，用于战术机动。

column1: Smart fix, Boss. Gauss slugs can be a nightmare to find past the Periphery line, but AC/5 rounds? Every two-bit depot from here to Tortuga keeps a crate or two. She hits a little softer now, sure, but a gun that shoots beats a gun that sits empty.
column2: 聪明的修复，老板。越过外围线寻找高斯弹头可能是一场噩梦，但是 AC/5 子弹？从这里到托尔图加的每个两位仓库都保留一两个板条箱。当然，她现在打得轻了一些，但是一把能射击的枪胜过一把空枪。

column1: So boss, this thing may look like a scout with it's ability to hit 130kph in a sprint without even using its supercharger, but its not. It is an assassin that is quickly able to maneuver around an opposing Mech and deliver a knockout blow to foes even twice its size.
column2: 所以老板，这东西可能看起来像一个侦察兵，它有能力在冲刺中击中 130kph，甚至不使用其增压器，但事实并非如此。它是一名刺客，能够快速绕过敌方机甲，并对两倍大小的敌人造成致命一击。

column1: So this is a worse MTR-6K. Sure, it has more weapons, but it will overheat so fast it is practically useless in any prolonged engagement. Not a 'Mech I'd keep, Boss. Better to refit it a -6K than cook yourself inside this thing.
column2: 所以这是一个更糟糕的MTR-6K。当然，它有更多的武器，但它会过热得如此之快，以至于在任何长时间的交战中几乎毫无用处。我不会保留机甲，老大。最好把它改装成-6K，而不是在这东西里煮自己。

column1: So this thing has about an average armament for its weight and sports decent armor that enable it to fulfill its primary mission of Air Defense just fine, but it also has a surprise..it floats!
column2: 因此，这个东西的重量大约是平均武器，并且具有不错的运动装甲，使其能够很好地完成其防空的主要任务，但它也有一个惊喜……它会漂浮！

column1: So you modified the files or had a bug, you should not have this mech. If it was a bug and you ended up with this mech please report it to Discord. If not think about this: You are riding around in a semi-sentient being's body.
column2: 所以你修改了文件或者有错误，你不应该拥有这个机械。如果这是一个错误，而您最终得到了这个机甲，请将其报告给 Discord。如果不考虑这一点：你正骑在一个半众生的身体里。

column1: Some High Octane sniffing Pirate got their hands on a perfectly fine Archer and turned it into this Monstrosity, carrying 2 LRM '30' and tons of Flamers.
column2: 一些高辛烷值嗅探海盗得到了一个完美的弓箭手，并将其变成了这个怪物，携带 2 LRM '30' 和大量的火焰喷射器。

column1: Some idiot got a hold of this poor ''Victor'', I'm not sure what all they did to his but somehow they strapped this monstrous thing on the right arm. They also scrawled ''The RACtor 9000'' in giant letters across the chest and drew a toothy grin over the cockpit glass. Yeah you heard me they painted over the duraplast. They also welded a damn flag pole onto the shoulder for flying a pirate flag.
column2: 某个白痴抓住了这个可怜的“维克多”，我不确定他们对他做了什么，但不知何故他们把这个可怕的东西绑在了右臂上。他们还在胸前用巨大的字母写下了“The RACtor 9000”，并在驾驶舱玻璃上画出了露齿的笑容。是的，你听到我说的，他们在杜拉塑料上涂漆。他们还在肩膀上焊了一根该死的旗杆，用来悬挂海盗旗。

column1: Some maniac crammed an enormous engine into this ancient Catapult II, and upgraded the weapons with the best streak launchers ever to come out of the Inner Sphere. Just hold down the trigger, boss.
column2: 一些疯子将一个巨大的引擎塞进了这个古老的弹射器 II 中，并用内层有史以来最好的条纹发射器升级了武器。按住扳机，老大。

column1: Some Pirate Band captured a messed up Kodiak, painted it pink, and replaced the cosmetic claws with a bunch of VibroClaws...... And Yeah, that is Pink Plush and Fluffy dice in the Cockpit
column2: 一些海盗乐队抓获了一艘乱七八糟的科迪亚克，把它涂成粉红色，并用一堆振动爪取代了装饰爪……是的，那就是驾驶舱里的粉色毛绒和蓬松骰子

column1: Some pirate became convinced that missiles were the strongest possible weapon system to mount in a mech so they have some custom job for a ballistic AMS system, and yet they fit the mech for melee combat. I'm scratching my head, boss.
column2: 一些海盗确信导弹是机甲中安装的最强大的武器系统，因此他们为弹道 AMS 系统进行了一些定制工作，但它们适合近战战斗。我正在摸不着头脑，老板。

column1: Some pirate really, really wanted full size autocannons in the legs of this rustbucket. I really wouldn't want anyone to try firing them.
column2: 一些海盗真的非常想要在这个铁锈桶的腿上安装全尺寸的自动加农炮。我真的不希望任何人尝试解雇他们。

column1: Someone over at Quicsell decided to see how fast they could make an Assault mech run. The answer is exactly this fast. If you take out the shitty Quicsell ammo, and those useless light machineguns, this actually stands to do some good work. You know, as the worlds largest Medium mech, since that's the role it'll fill on the battlefield.
column2: Quisell 的某人决定看看他们能让突击机甲跑多快。答案就是这么快。如果你拿出那些糟糕的Quicsell弹药和那些无用的轻机枪，这实际上可以起到一些很好的作用。你知道，作为世界上最大的中型机甲，因为这就是它将在战场上扮演的角色。

column1: Someone painted big White Bunny on this one... I've got no idea what the hell they've been thinking
column2: 有人在这上面画了一个大白兔……我不知道他们到底在想什么

column1: Someone stole this Barghest from the Blakists, and it's taken a good beating since then, Boss. Almost every scrap of the internals have been replaced, and they've managed to stuff some weird-looking pulse lasers into the Legs. This Periphery "Shotgun" takes the cake, though. It has internal ammo, looks like someone tried to build an LBX out of duct tape. The entire Cockpit has been re-engineered, complete with a distille and one of those music boxes they have in some older bars. The distille is somehow routed through the Coolshot, it makes some kind of Schnapps.
column2: 有人从布莱克派那里偷走了这只 Barghest，从那以后它就遭受了重创，老大。几乎所有的内部碎片都被更换了，他们还成功地将一些看起来怪异的脉冲激光塞进了腿部。不过，这款外围“霰弹枪”更胜一筹。它有内部弹药，看起来就像有人试图用胶带制作 LBX。整个驾驶舱都经过重新设计，配有蒸馏器和一些旧酒吧里的音乐盒。蒸馏酒以某种方式通过 Coolshot，制成某种杜松子酒。

column1: Someone thought the Hatchetman couldn't kill well enough at arm's length and came up with the -3X. It's brimming with as many short range weapon systems as its well-armored chassis can take. This is truly death at point blank range, Boss. Just watch the heat on this one.
column2: 有人认为，”刽子手“在近战战中不够致命. 所以3X诞生了. 该机甲配备了尽可能多的短程武器，装甲有精良的底盘. 如果那东西靠得太近，就是那个，老板. 你应该只关注热量的发展.

column1: Somne pirate took a Lament, ripped of some of its structure to make it lighter and gave it a sword. The result was apparently given the name the Lamentor.
column2: 索姆海盗拿走了一艘哀歌，撕掉了它的一些结构以使其更轻，并给了它一把剑。结果显然被命名为“哀叹者”。

column1: Sooo some Pirate got their hands on a Bushwacker, and stuffed it full of Inferno weapons, theres even a smoker in the cockpit!
column2: 一些海盗拿到了一辆丛林瓦克，并在里面装满了地狱武器，驾驶舱里甚至还有一个吸烟者！

column1: Specifically Built, and Made without Question for a Periphery Noble (is there even such a Title?), This Stiletto is supposed to Show the Wonders of MML Launchers. Sadly, due to Tonnage Issues, only one Ton Per Launcher Type were added to this Stiletto. It was Primarily Used for Parade Duty, Rarely seen on the Combat Field.
column2: 专为外围贵族打造，毫无疑问地制造（甚至有这样的标题吗？），这款 Stiletto 应该展示 MML 发射器的奇迹。遗憾的是，由于吨位问题，每种发射器类型仅添加一吨到该短剑中。它主要用于阅兵任务，在战场上很少见到。

column1: Sporting extensive ClanTech Replacements recovered during the Damocles Campaign, showing the MFB Team's ingenuity under the guide of Thomas Sorenson.
column2: 达摩克利斯战役期间回收的大量 ClanTech 替换品，展示了 MFB 团队在托马斯·索伦森 (Thomas Sorenson) 的指导下的独创性。

column1: Sporting two Type 3 Series ATM 3s plus two Series 6a ER Medium Lasers and four General Systems Micro Pulse Lasers, allowing the Eyrie good mobility and armor, as well as great up-close firepower for its size and a minimized ammunition dependence. The Eyrie also includes talons in its legs, allowing it to rip important armor pieces apart while performing Death from Above maneuvers.
column2: 配备两台 3 型系列 ATM 3s 加上两台 6a ER 系列中型激光器和四台通用系统微脉冲激光器，使 Eyrie 具有良好的机动性和装甲，以及因其尺寸而具有强大的近距离火力和最小化的弹药依赖性。鹰巢城的腿上还带有爪子，使其能够在执行“天上死亡”机动时撕开重要的装甲碎片。

column1: Standing ten meters tall, the Watchman is a 'Mech that was born of necessity. The idea for the design came when the bulk of the AFFS was moved to the Clan front. Because this seriously undermined the ability of the Federated Suns to keep its borders secure, the Watchman was designed to be distributed to militia units within the border marches to bulk up their strength. In its own right the Watchman is a durable and reliable 'Mech that is built with off the shelf components and is very easy to repair.
column2: 守望者身高十米，是一款因需要而诞生的机甲。当 AFFS 的大部分被移至氏族前部时，就有了设计的想法。由于这严重削弱了太阳联邦维护边境安全的能力，守望者被设计为分发给边境行军中的民兵部队，以增强他们的兵力。就其本身而言，守望者是一款耐用且可靠的机甲，采用现成的组件制成，并且非常易于维修。

column1: Still an infantry killer, the IIC 7 mounts a trio of Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifles in each arm. One meager ton of ammunition supplies this variant. The ER Medium Laser of the IIC 4 remains in place. A Targeting Computer enhances these weapons' accuracy.
column2: IIC 7 仍然是步兵杀手，每只手臂上都安装了三支杀伤人员高斯步枪。这种变体只需一吨微薄的弹药。 IIC 4 的 ER 中型激光器保持在原位。瞄准计算机提高了这些武器的准确性。

column1: Stormcrow F is equipped with 2 Plasma Cannons to increase the target's heat. Against infantry this variant is equipped with AP Gauss Rifles. Against hardened targets, it has four ER Medium Lasers.
column2: Stormcrow F 配备 2 门等离子炮以增加目标的热量。针对步兵，该变体配备了 AP 高斯步枪。针对坚硬目标，它有四个 ER 中型激光器。

column1: Surprised anybody'd bother with upgrading an old rustbucket like this and not go the whole nine yards. Either way, this is a solid foundation for us to work off, if you want us to.
column2: 令人惊讶的是，有人会费心升级像这样的旧铁桶，而不是走完整的九码。无论哪种方式，如果您希望我们这样做，这都是我们工作的坚实基础。

column1: The Black Knight 7B is a refit made for and sold to Mercenary Commanders deeply in favour with the Federated Commonwealth, sporting advanced Technologies and Prototype X-Pulse Laser.
column2: 黑骑士 7B 是为深得联邦联邦青睐的佣兵指挥官制造并出售的改装型，配备先进技术和原型 X 脉冲激光。

column1: The Hunchback 1G is a primitive refit trying to retain the 4G's impressive firepower by replacing the weapons with a Medium and Heavy Rifle in place of the AC/20.
column2: 驼背 1G 是原始改装型，试图以一门中型和一门重型步枪取代 AC/20，从而保留 4G 令人印象深刻的火力。

column1: The Kintaro 18 is a beast of a machine. It's fast for its size, mounts heavy 装甲, and can literally shred most other '机甲s with its almost ridiculous amount of close-range weaponry. But, it runs hotter than Hell's saunas.
column2: “金太郎 18”是......机器中的猛兽. 在这个级别里它很快，配有厚重的装甲，能用近乎荒谬的大把近程武器真正地撕碎其它大部分机甲. 但是，它会比地狱的桑拿还热.

column1: The original Longbow built in 2480, carried twin LRM-20s each with three tons of ammunition, supported by two Medium Lasers and a Small Laser. The Primitive Technology used limited the design's top speed to 54 km/h, but this was deemed acceptable for a fire support unit.
column2: 原版长弓于 2480 年建造，携带双联 LRM-20（各配三吨弹药），辅以两门中型激光和一门小型激光。所使用的原始技术把该设计的最高速度限制在 54 公里/小时，但这对于火力支援单位而言可以接受。

column1: The Shadow Hawk 2D is an interesting model. Its default payload sacrifices a lot of 装甲 to mount a bit more firepower, though some argue the tradeoff isn't worth it. Its Alpha Strikes are better, though, so I guess you can be the judge.
column2: “影鹰 2D”是种有趣的型号. 它的默认装载牺牲了许多装甲来安装多一点的火力，不过有人论证这样的取舍是不值得的. 不过，它的全弹攻击更 好. 所以......我猜你自己能判断.

column1: This is a Sherrif's mech, It brings a piece of mind to folk, but is not heavy on technology.
column2: 这是一台治安官机甲，它让民众安心，但技术含量不高。

column1: This is one hell of a 'Mech, Boss. Look at all that Clan Tech, and tell me you don't want to take it for a ride. I guess we should be happy there are not more of these around, or battles would be a lot tougher.
column2: 这是一台地狱般的机甲，老板。看看所有的氏族科技，告诉我你不想搭便车。我想我们应该庆幸周围没有更多这样的东西，否则战斗会更加艰难。

column1: This is one impressive missile platform, but quite expensive to field with all its high tech parts. Still, worth every penny in my book, Boss.
column2: 这是一个令人印象深刻的导弹平台，但其所有高科技部件的部署成本相当昂贵。尽管如此，我的书里的每一分钱都值得，老板。

column1: This is one of Jalastar Aerospace's Gunsmith 'Mechs, greatly upgraded and retrofitted. The X-Pulses have been replaced with Medium Heavy Lasers, with a special FCS installed to help control the heat. A Clan-tech MASC and enormous XL engine ensure it's the fastest 'Mech on the battlefield, while the heavily upgraded arm actuators help hitting a shot on the run. Boss, this thing is extremely dangerous, and fast even for a light. Whoever used this 'Mech must have been one hell of a crack shot to hit anything at these speeds.
column2: 这是贾拉斯塔航空航天公司的枪匠机甲之一，经过大幅升级和改装。 X 脉冲已被中型重型激光器取代，并安装了特殊的 FCS 来帮助控制热量。氏族科技 MASC 和巨大的 XL 发动机确保其成为战场上最快的机甲，而大幅升级的手臂执行器有助于在奔跑中射击。老大，这东西极其危险，连光都快。无论谁使用这台机甲，他一定是一位神枪手，能够以这样的速度击中任何东西。

column1: This is pretty lightly armored for an assault mech, but at least Quicsell included some of their knockoff CASE II to prevent the entire mech from going up like a firework the first time it takes a penetrating hit. They must have worked out a licensing deal for that pile of Tandem LRM ammo, since most of the ammo in the mech is their shitty house brand. If you can find a good double heatsink kit, it'd be worth ripping out Quicsell's attempt at one.
column2: 对于突击机甲来说，这是相当轻的装甲，但至少 Quicsell 包括了一些他们的仿制品 CASE II，以防止整个机甲在第一次受到穿透击中时像烟花一样升起。他们肯定已经为那堆 Tandem LRM 弹药达成了许可协议，因为机甲中的大部分弹药都是他们的劣质自家品牌。如果你能找到一个好的双散热器套件，那么值得放弃 Quicsell 的尝试。

column1: This is the toughest Wasp I've ever seen, boss. Not that it's a high bar to surpass, mind you. It's only lightly armed, with most of it's firepower coming from the ultra-light rotary trash. Still, it would make a good training mech for rookie light mech pilots.
column2: 这是我见过的最难对付的黄蜂，老板。请注意，这并不是一个需要超越的高标准。它只是轻武装，大部分火力来自超轻型旋转垃圾车。尽管如此，对于新手轻型机甲飞行员来说，它仍然是一个很好的训练机甲。

column1: This Jenner was first fielded in 2784, the same year the Exodus fleet that would eventually become the Clans left the Inner Sphere. How exactly they acquired this design in that short time frame is not known, but what is known is that it belonged to a Kuritan lieutenant. The name translates to 'Fast', or 'the First'. Looking at the Specs of this 'Mech, it definitely fills that Role. The speed of this 'Mech, together with its upgrades, leaves me to believe this was designed to ram its opponents. There are spikes on every part, upgraded Leg Actuators, and Protective Padding all over the whole 'Mech. All of the electronics have been upgraded to support the calculations and projections needed in melee combat. If it can't ram, it has just two micro lasers to fall back on.
column2: 这艘詹纳号于 2784 年首次投入使用，同年，最终成为氏族的出埃及舰队离开了内天体。他们究竟是如何在这么短的时间内获得这个设计的，目前尚不清楚，但已知的是它属于库里坦中尉。该名称翻译为“快速”或“第一”。看看这个“机甲”的规格，它绝对可以胜任这个角色。这个机甲的速度，加上它的升级，让我相信它是为了撞击对手而设计的。每个零件上都有尖刺，升级的腿部执行器，以及遍布整个“机甲”的保护垫。所有电子设备均已升级，以支持近战战斗所需的计算和预测。如果它无法撞击，它就只有两个微型激光器可以依靠。

column1: This Jihad-era field refit Vulcan carries two extra heat sinks and a Plasma Rifle while retaining the medium laser, machine gun and flamer. Outfitted with MASC, the 'Mech could escape with a short speed boost from a dangerous situation.
column2: 这辆圣战时代的野战改装火神配备了两个额外的散热器和一支等离子步枪，同时保留了中型激光、机枪和火焰喷射器。配备了 MASC 的“机甲”可以在危险情况下通过短暂的速度提升来逃脱。

column1: This Jihad-era variant appears to be a test-bed used by the Word of Blake. Its performance is identical to the WSP-100 and it retains the bomb bay, but it is built on a Composite Internal Structure. It's also equipped with double heat sinks and a Medium Variable Speed Pulse Laser. The one shot missile launcher has been removed.
column2: 这个圣战时代的变体似乎是布莱克之言使用的试验台。其性能与 WSP-100 相同，并保留了炸弹舱，但采用复合内部结构。它还配备了双散热器和中变速脉冲激光器。一发导弹发射器已被拆除。

column1: This Jihad-era variant developed in 3081 drops all the weaponry in favor of a single Heavy PPC. The 'Mech makes room for this by using an XL Gyro and a smaller XL Engine that reduces the top speed to approximately 110 km/h. This Osiris variant has a 210 meter jump capability and is protected by Light Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: 这种圣战时代的变体于 3081 年开发，放弃了所有武器，转而采用单一重型 PPC。 机甲 通过使用 XL 陀螺仪和较小的 XL 发动机来为此腾出空间，将最高速度降低至约 110 公里/小时。这个奥西里斯变体具有 210 米的跳跃能力，并受到轻质铁纤维装甲的保护。

column1: This Legacy uses the same frame and engine as the 03 model but uses a Compact Gyro to provide enough room to add MASC. This means it can reach a speed of 86 km/h. The weaponry has been replaced with a pair of Snub-Nose PPCs, and the hand actuators have been replaced by Claws. The standard armor is replaced by Light Ferro-Fibrous.
column2: 这款 Legacy 使用与 03 型号相同的车架和发动机，但使用紧凑型陀螺仪来提供足够的空间来添加 MASC。这意味着它的速度可以达到86公里/小时。武器已更换为一对扁鼻 PPC，手动执行器已更换为利爪。标准装甲被轻铁纤维取代。

column1: This Legendary variant is barely spoken of for fear it might appear, bringing 4 massive Thumper Cannons to the field on a very very slow platform.
column2: 这个传奇变体几乎没有被提及，因为担心它可能会出现，在一个非常非常慢的平台上将 4 门巨大的重击炮带到战场上。

column1: This looks like it once was a CN9-A, but nothing is quite like where it needs to be, they somehow went overweight with reinforcing the shield.
column2: 看起来它曾经是 CN9-A，但一切都不像它需要的那样，他们不知何故在加固防护罩时变得超重了。

column1: This looks like one of Skobels MKII Vultures, and it looks way too pristine to have been Battlefield Salvage. Something ain't right here, Boss.
column2: 这看起来像一架 Skobels MKII 秃鹰，而且看起来太原始了，不可能是战场打捞的。这里有些不对劲，老板。

column1: This Lyran model is meant for close range and restrictive terrain. It carries two highly destructive LB-X Autocannon/20s that can create holes in an enemy's armor using slug rounds with ease, then exploit those holes to damage critical systems with the cluster rounds. Three Medium Pulse Lasers and a regular Medium Laser provide energy backup.
column2: 这款 Lyran 模型适用于近距离和限制性地形。它携带两枚极具破坏性的 LB-X Autocannon/20s，可以使用子弹轻松地在敌人的装甲上打出洞，然后利用这些洞用集束子弹损坏关键系统。三个中型脉冲激光器和一个常规中型激光器提供能量备份。

column1: This Marauder II was introduced by the Clans for a Mercenary who earned a honoured place among the Warriors.
column2: 这款掠夺者 II 是由部落为一位在勇士中赢得光荣地位的雇佣兵推出的。

column1: This Marauder, commonly refered as the MAD-DER, was first seen as a Solaris VII speed boosted refit which boasts of a L.A.M. System incorporated to the very mech's chassis and engine, enabling it to go faster and actually fly in short bursts. In botched attempt to make a Marauder into a L.A.M. the armor and it's unique JJ system got fused into the chassis making it impossible to make heavy modifications to the mech. I guess some sacrifices needed to be made for a 75-Ton ''Flying'' mech.
column2: 这架掠夺者通常被称为 MAD-DER，最初被视为 Solaris VII 速度增强改装，拥有 L.A.M.该系统与机甲的底盘和发动机相结合，使其能够行驶得更快，并且实际上可以在短时间内飞行。将掠夺者变成 L.A.M. 的尝试失败了。装甲及其独特的 JJ 系统被融合到底盘中，使得无法对机甲进行重大修改。我想，对于一个 75 吨的“飞行”机甲来说，需要做出一些牺牲。

column1: This Marauder's undergone so many upgrades I'm not even sure you could still call it a 1R. It's like the SLDF made the Ship of Theseus in 'Mech form.
column2: 这款掠夺者经历了如此多的升级，我什至不确定你是否还可以称它为 1R。这就像 SLDF 以“机甲”形式制作了忒修斯之船。

column1: This may be the fastest fifty-ton chassis I've ever worked on, boss. The Crab already moves at a pretty respectable clip, but this is something else entirely. If my calculations are correct, this thing can push over just over 140 km/h while both the MASC and supercharger are active. Just ... well, remember to turn them off once in a while, ya hear?
column2: 这可能是我设计过的最快的五十吨底盘了，老板。螃蟹已经以相当可观的速度移动了，但这完全是另一回事。如果我的计算正确的话，当 MASC 和增压器都处于活动状态时，这个东西可以推动超过 140 公里/小时。只是......好吧，记得偶尔把它们关掉，听到了吗？

column1: This mech is a solution in need of a problem. Nobody needs a 65 ton mech to move that fast, and it doesn't even have jumpjets, so you can't take advantage of the mobility most of the time. On the plus side, any medium mechs you catch will be crushed beneath this thing's fists. Just, go easy on those PPCs. They run too hot for the cooling system to handle.
column2: 该机甲是需要问题的解决方案。没有人需要 65 吨的机甲来移动那么快，而且它甚至没有跳跃喷气机，所以大多数时候你无法利用机动性。从好的方面来说，你抓住的任何中型机甲都会被这个东西的拳头压碎。只是，在这些 PPC 上放轻松一些。它们运行得太热，冷却系统无法处理。

column1: This mech is a solution in search of a problem, if you ask me. Quicsell got so wrapped up in making chem lasers stronger that they forgot to ask why people stopped using them. Aside from my gripes about the weapons, my main complaint is the speed. Thanks to that underweight fuel cell that's hardwired in, this mech is just never going to move above assault mech speeds, which is just embarrasing for a medium.
column2: 如果你问我的话，这个机械就是寻找问题的解决方案。奎塞尔如此专注于让化学激光器变得更强，以至于他们忘记了问为什么人们停止使用它们。除了我对武器的抱怨之外，我主要的抱怨是速度。由于内置了重量较轻的燃料电池，该机甲永远不会超过突击机甲的速度，这对于介质来说是令人尴尬的。

column1: This mech is terrifying. Oh, sure it can produce a lot of firepower, but I'm mostly scared because of how damn much ammo is in the side torsos. That knock-off Quicsell CASE II is the only thing keeping you from a very impressive death if you so much as look at the internals of the mech. Oh, and did I mention that Quicsell CASE can be destroyed with a good shot? Suddenly, there goes seven tons of high explosives; and that's just in the one torso!
column2: 这机甲太恐怖了哦，当然它可以产生大量的火力，但我最害怕的是因为侧面躯干有那么多该死的弹药。如果你仔细看看机甲的内部结构，那件山寨版的 Quicsell CASE II 是唯一能让你避免令人印象深刻的死亡的东西。哦，我有没有提到过，Quicsell CASE 可以用一枪摧毁？突然，七吨烈性炸药飞了出去；那只是在一个躯干中！

column1: This Medusa was named after a Wolfs Dragoons Honorname, being piloted by one of Said Dragoons. Outfitted with an array of Equipment to increase the Jump Distance to get easier into Close Range, An Upgraded Ewar package also helps with any Dezgra Stealth Units. Almost all of the Equipment on this Medusa was won by Trial of Possessions, from every Clan and House. Whilst being a 'Hand me Down', its also an Honour to Pilot the Mech, making the Pilots Ferocious in Battle and Inspiring Nearby Mechs.
column2: 这头美杜莎以狼队龙骑兵的荣誉名称命名，由赛义德龙骑兵之一驾驶。升级版 Ewar 套件配备了一系列设备，可以增加跳跃距离，更容易进入近距离，还可以帮助任何 Dezgra 隐形单位。这美杜莎身上的装备，几乎都是通过财产试炼获得的，来自各个氏族和家族。在成为“放手”的同时，驾驶机甲也是一种荣幸，使飞行员在战斗中表现凶猛，并激励附近的机甲。

column1: This modified Elemental version was created by Clan Jade Falcon engineers in 3069 and replaces SRM ammunition with Fire-Resistant Armor. It carries a one-shot SRM-2 and an AP Gauss Rifle.
column2: 这个修改后的元素版本是由玉隼氏族工程师于 3069 年创建的，并用防火装甲取代了 SRM 弹药。它携带一把单发 SRM-2 和一把 AP 高斯步枪。

column1: This must have belonged to a powerful pirate, since it's not nearly as broken as you'd expect, and it's carrying some LosTech.
column2: 这肯定属于一个强大的海盗，因为它并不像你想象的那么破损，而且还携带着一些洛斯科技。

column1: This new variant removes the Small Laser and upgrades the mediums to a pair of ER Medium Lasers. The weight savings enables the inclusion of a C3i Computer.
column2: 这个新版本移除了小型激光器，并将中型激光器升级为一对 ER 中型激光器。重量减轻使得可以包含 C3i 计算机。

column1: This newer variant on the IIC 4 uses three Heavy Machine Guns in each arm.
column2: IIC 4 上的这款较新型号的每只手臂均使用三挺重机枪。

column1: This next generation Urbanmech; is a rare product from the mysterious Institute of Strategic combat. Built around a prototype Hyperlaser, this Urbie can wield nearly unparalleled destructive capabilities. As with all RISC products, it must be used with care; lest it explode or suffer a catastrophic misfire.
column2: 下一代 Urbanmech；是来自神秘的战略作战研究所的稀有产品。这个 Urbie 围绕原型超级激光构建，可以发挥几乎无与伦比的破坏能力。与所有RISC产品一样，必须小心使用；以免爆炸或遭受灾难性的失火。

column1: This next generation Urbanmech; is a rare product from the mysterious Institute of Strategic combat. Built around a RISC spec HPPC, this Urbie is a surprisingly nasty skirmisher. As with all RISC products, it must be used with care; lest it explode or suffer a catastrophic misfire.
column2: 下一代 Urbanmech；是来自神秘的战略作战研究所的稀有产品。这款 Urbie 围绕 RISC 规格 HPPC 构建，是一款令人惊讶的令人讨厌的散兵。与所有RISC产品一样，必须小心使用；以免爆炸或遭受灾难性的失火。

column1: This Titan variant was introduced during the Dark Ages. Built around 3 standard PPCs, it carries a mix of srm 4's and medium lasers as secondary weapons. 16 DHS keep the heat under control.
column2: 这种泰坦变种是在黑暗时代引入的。它围绕 3 个标准 PPC 构建，混合使用 srm 4 和中型激光器作为辅助武器。 16 DHS 控制热量。

column1: This variant also uses a Small Cockpit. It also uses a Heavy Duty Gyro. The traditional Vanquisher weaponry has been replaced by a Rotary AC/5 in each arm, while the side torsos each carry a Light PPC. For a a heavy knockout punch, there is a Heavy PPC in the right torso.
column2: 该变体还使用小型驾驶舱。它还使用重型陀螺仪。传统的征服者武器已被每只手臂上的旋转 AC/5 所取代，而侧面躯干各携带一把轻型 PPC。对于重型击倒拳，右躯干中有一个重型 PPC。

column1: This variant carries a pair of Streak SRM-6s in the right torso and a Streak LRM-15 in the left. The Mad Dog G carries a single ER PPC in the left arm, while the right mounts a trio of ER Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: 该变体的右躯干带有一对 Streak SRM-6s，左侧带有一对 Streak LRM-15。 Mad Dog G 的左臂携带一个 ER PPC，而右臂则安装三个 ER 中脉冲激光器。

column1: This variant is a capable knife fighter. Six Jump Jets give it a maximum jumping distance of 180 meters. A Snub-Nose PPC deals damage at long range, but is more powerful up close. A pair of Medium Pulse Lasers are highly accurate, as are the twin Small Pulse Lasers that are so devastating against infantry.
column2: 这个变体是一个有能力的刀战士。六台跳跃喷气机使其最大跳跃距离可达 180 米。扁鼻子 PPC 在远​​距离造成伤害，但近距离时威力更大。一对中型脉冲激光器非常精确，一对小型脉冲激光器对步兵具有毁灭性打击。

column1: This variant is based on the VQR-7V, but replaces the heavy duty gyro with a Compact Gyro. It has a Gauss Rifle in the right arm and two Large Variable Speed Pulse Lasers in the left arm as its main striking power. Supporting these are twin MML-3s and two ER Medium Lasers. Two tons of ammo are carried for the MMLs and Gauss Rifle. This variant was used by Demi-Precentor Pravuil, who was second in command of the 40th Shadow Division.
column2: 该变体基于 VQR-7V，但用紧凑型陀螺仪取代了重型陀螺仪。右臂配备一把高斯步枪，左臂配备两把大型变速脉冲激光器作为主要打击力量。支持这些的是两个 MML-3s 和两个 ER 中型激光器。 MML 和高斯步枪携带两吨弹药。这个变体由半前任普拉维尔使用，他是 40th 暗影师的第二指挥官。

column1: This variant of the 2D chassis was used as a prototype platform for pulse lasers.
column2: 2D 底盘的这种变体被用作脉冲激光器的原型平台。

column1: This variant of the Piranha is fielded by Clan Ice Hellion and upgrades to double heat sinks so that the Machine Guns can be effectively swapped out for ER Micro Lasers. The other lasers were upgraded to heavy models.
column2: 食人鱼的这种变体由 Clan Ice Hellion 部署，并升级为双散热器，以便机枪可以有效地更换为 ER 微型激光器。其他激光器升级为重型型号。

column1: This variant swaps out the Thunderbolt Launchers in favor of two Clan-tech Gauss Rifles and replaces the ER Lasers with two M-Pods. A supercharged XXL engine allows this variant to reach speeds approaching 90 km/h.
column2: 该变体用两支氏族科技高斯步枪取代了雷电发射器，并用两支 M-Pod 取代了 ER 激光器。增压 XXL 发动机使这款车型的时速接近 90 公里/小时。

column1: This variant takes the primary configuration, downgrades the pulse laser to an ER Medium and replaces the Machine Guns with three Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifles.
column2: 该变体采用主要配置，将脉冲激光降级为 ER 中型，并用三支杀伤人员高斯步枪取代机枪。

column1: This variant trades some weapons for better sensor capabilities over the MTR-5K. Not sure which you prefer, Boss, but whichever of the two variants you choose they will both serve you well, I am sure.
column2: 该变体用一些武器换取了比 MTR-5K 更好的传感器能​​力。不确定您更喜欢哪一个，老板，但无论您选择这两种变体中的哪一种，我相信它们都会很好地为您服务。

column1: This variant uses a Compact Engine and Compact Gyro to increase survivability. It has the same top speed as the standard Legacy and drops the jump range to sixty meters. Each arm carries a Medium Variable Speed Pulse Laser and a Light PPC, supported by two torso mounted MML-7s with Artemis IV fire control systems. A head-mounted ER Small Laser rounds out the armament. Thirteen double heat sinks are installed as well.
column2: 该变体使用紧凑型发动机和紧凑型陀螺仪来提高生存能力。它具有与标准 Legacy 相同的最高速度，并将跳跃范围降至 60 米。每只手臂都携带一个中型变速脉冲激光器和一个轻型 PPC，由两个安装在躯干上的 MML-7s 和 Artemis IV 火控系统提供支持。头戴式 ER 小型激光器使武器更加完善。还安装了十三个双散热器。

column1: This version carries a HAG/30 in each arm and eight tons of ammunition in CASE protected bays.
column2: 该版本的每只手臂上都装有 HAG/30，并在 CASE 保护舱内装载了 8 吨弹药。

column1: This version carries an ER Large Laser and pair of AP Gauss Rifles in each arm. These are supported by a Streak SRM-6 mounted in the left and right torsos. A head mounted ECM Suite can disrupt targeting networks, and five jump jets allow the IIC 8 to cover 150 meters at a time. The Endo Steel chassis allowed the engineers to install a Consolidated 325 XL engine, increasing ground speed to a maximum of 86 km/h.
column2: 该版本的每只手臂上都携带有 ER 大型激光枪和一对 AP 高斯步枪。这些由安装在左右躯干的 Streak SRM-6 提供支持。头戴式 ECM 套件可以扰乱目标网络，五个跳跃喷气机使 IIC 8 一次覆盖 150 米。 Endo Steel 底盘允许工程师安装 Consolidated 325 XL 发动机，将行驶速度提高到最大 86 公里/小时。

column1: This version is built with Clan technology similar to the Marauder II C. It uses a standard 300-rated Fusion Engine with sixteen tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel internal structure. It is armed with an ER PPC and two Medium Pulse Lasers in each arm. A Gauss Rifle sits in the right torso with two tons of ammunition, and a Targeting Computer is in the left torso for increased accuracy. It has a Clan-tech CASE system to protect the Gauss Rifle, and can jump 90 meters at a time.
column2: 该版本采用与 Marauder II C 类似的 Clan 技术建造。它使用标准 300 级融合引擎，配有 16 吨铁纤维装甲和远藤钢内部结构。它的每只手臂上都配备了 ER PPC 和两个中脉冲激光器。右侧躯干装有一把装有两吨弹药的高斯步枪，左侧躯干装有一台瞄准计算机以提高准确性。它拥有部落科技CASE系统来保护高斯步枪，并且一次可以跳跃90米。

column1: This version of the Banshee carries a Heavy PPC, two Light PPCs, Gauss Rifle, and an ER Medium Laser. All these weapons are tied into a Targeting Computer, and a C3 Boosted Slave allows it to share targeting data with other friendly units. It uses a light fusion engine and XL Gyro to free weight for these weapons and equipment.
column2: 该版本的女妖携带一门重型 PPC、两门轻型 PPC、高斯步枪和一门 ER 中型激光器。所有这些武器都与目标计算机相连，C3 Boosted Slave 允许它与其他友方单位共享目标数据。它使用轻型聚变发动机和XL陀螺仪来为这些武器和装备减轻重量。

column1: This version of the Cephalus carries a Plasma Cannon and a Flamer. This configuration is apparently intended as an anti-infantry unit.
column2: 这个版本的 Cephalus 携带等离子炮和火焰喷射器。这种配置显然是作为反步兵单位使用的。

column1: This version of the Fireball, debuting in 3076, uses Extended Range Lasers instead of the standard versions. A MASC system boosts the 'Mech's maximum speed and Heavy Ferro-Fibrous armor increases protection. The machine also has a Targeting Computer for better accuracy.
column2: 该版本的火球于 3076 年首次亮相，使用增程激光器而不是标准版本。 MASC 系统提高了机甲的最大速度，重型铁纤维装甲增强了保护。该机器还配备了瞄准计算机，以提高准确性。

column1: This version of the Hoplite was decorated by some pirate to actually look like a Triple F burger. It comes equipped with paired Small Rotary Chemical Lasers and 10-Tube LRM racks.
column2: 这个版本的重装步兵被一些海盗装饰得实际上看起来像一个 Triple F 汉堡。它配备了成对的小型旋转化学激光器和 10 管 LRM 机架。

column1: This version of the Minotaur was created by Clan Hell's Horses. The jump jets and standard weapons were removed and replaced by two Improved Heavy Small Lasers and an SRM-5 launcher. The weight saved from this weapon switch allowed the engineers to maximize the armor protection of the Minotaur-XP
column2: 这个版本的牛头怪是由地狱马氏族创造的。跳跃喷气机和标准武器被移除，并被两架改进型重型小型激光器和一个 SRM-5 发射器取代。该武器开关节省的重量使工程师能够最大限度地提高 Minotaur-XP 的装甲保护

column1: This version received 2 Mag Shot rifles in place of its MGs as well as 2 ER Small Lasers.
column2: 该版本配备了 2 支 Mag Shot 步枪来代替 MG，以及 2 支 ER 小型激光器。

column1: This version removes the jump jets in favor of one more ton of armor.
column2: 这个版本去掉了跳跃喷气机，转而增加了一吨装甲。

column1: This version uses an experimental Composite Structure as its skeleton. An XL Engine and MASC allow this Stealth variant to reach speeds of 140 km/h. In addition, several Clan spec systems have been installed on the chassis, including an Active Probe, ECM Suite, a Streak SRM-6, and a trio of ER Medium Lasers. Two arm mounted ER Flamers provide anti-infantry capabilities. Most interesting is the use of a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield to make this Stealth live up to its name.
column2: 该版本使用实验性复合结构作为其骨架。 XL 发动机和 MASC 使这款 Stealth 变体的速度达到 140 公里/小时。此外，底盘上还安装了多个 Clan 规格系统，包括 Active Probe、ECM Suite、Streak SRM-6 和三个 ER Medium Lasers。两个安装在手臂上的 ER 火焰喷射器提供反步兵能力。最有趣的是使用变色龙光偏振护罩使这款隐形飞机名副其实。

column1: This version uses enough Improved Jump Jets to vault up to 150 meters at a time. Nineteen double heat sinks keep the heat from three ER Large Lasers and two Medium Pulse Lasers in check. The IIC 5 is a capable mobile sniper.
column2: 该版本使用足够的改进型跳跃喷气机，一次跳高可达 150 米。十九个双散热器可控制来自三个 ER 大型激光器和两个中型脉冲激光器的热量。 IIC 5 是一款强大的移动狙击手。

column1: This version uses two Machine Gun Arrays to make it more effective in combat. One array mounts Light Machine Guns, while the other mounts standard Machine Guns. The ER Medium Lasers are tied into a Targeting Computer as well.
column2: 该版本使用两个机枪阵列，使其在战斗中更加有效。一组安装轻机枪，另一组安装标准机枪。 ER 中型激光器也与瞄准计算机相连。

column1: This version was apparently created by the Word of Blake, as it removes the Beagle Probe and a Medium Laser from the PHX-HK1R and replaces that equipment with an Improved C3 Computer. The Snub-Nose PPC remains and the two remaining lasers are extended-range models.
column2: 这个版本显然是由布莱克的话语创建的，因为它从 PHX-HK1R 中删除了 Beagle 探针和中型激光器，并用改进的 C3 计算机取代了该设备。 Snub-Nose PPC 保留下来，剩下的两个激光器是增程型号。

column1: This version was produced for Clan Jade Falcon by Red Devil Industries in 3083. Using an experimental XXL Engine and Improved Jump Jets to provide mobility, the chassis is protected by Ferro-Fibrous Armor. Each arm mounts an ER Large Laser and Improved Heavy Medium Laser.
column2: 该版本由 Red Devil Industries 于 3083 年为 Clan Jade Falcon 生产。使用实验性 XXL 引擎和改进的跳跃喷气机来提供机动性，底盘由铁纤维装甲保护。每个臂安装一个 ER 大型激光器和改进型重型中型激光器。

column1: This version, introduced in 3077, is based on the 11-C as well but uses an experimental C3 Boosted Master computer to cut through the ECM commonly found on Jihad-era battlefields. It carries a Streak SRM-4, Gauss Rifle, and an ER Medium Laser in each arm.
column2: 该版本于 3077 年推出，同样基于 11-C，但使用实验性 C3 Boosted Master 计算机来突破圣战时代战场上常见的 ECM。它的每只手臂上都携带一支 Streak SRM-4、高斯步枪和一支 ER 中型激光器。

column1: This very expensively upgraded Roughneck came from a militia man turned Solaris Gladiator. Mixed Clan and Inner Sphere tech makes this a marvel of technology, with a Battle Rifle in one hand and a heavy shield in the other. It has a MRM40 and Narc to round out its weaponry, while heavily reinforced reactive armour makes this a very tough opponent. This 'Mech was a labour of love, for both its Mechwarrior and MekTek.
column2: 这个经过非常昂贵的升级的硬汉来自一名民兵，后来变成了索拉里斯角斗士。混合氏族和内部领域技术使其成为技术奇迹，一手拿着战斗步枪，另一只手拿着重型盾牌。它拥有 MRM40 和缉毒警察来完善其武器，而强化的反应装甲使其成为一个非常强大的对手。对于 机甲战士 和 MekTek 来说，这款 机甲 都是爱的结晶。

column1: This Victor variant emerged during the Jihad. Equipped with five Improved Jump Jets, it can rapidly close with enemy forces to bring its Autocannon/20 into play. Six tons of ammunition allow the pilot to choose from many types of special ammunition. The only drawback to this model is that it only has a single Medium Laser for backup.
column2: 这种维克多变体是在圣战期间出现的。配备五架改良型跳跃喷气机，可以快速接近敌军，发挥Autocannon/20的作用。六吨弹药允许飞行员从多种类型的特种弹药中进行选择。该型号的唯一缺点是它只有一个中型激光器用于备份。

column1: This was once a very solid Dagger, until some pirate went at it and broke the advanced electronics, it still has some after market Warfare Suite and Stealth Systems, but I wouldnt trust them.
column2: 这曾经是一把非常坚固的匕首，直到一些海盗袭击它并破坏了先进的电子设备，它仍然有一些售后战争套件和隐形系统，但我不会相信它们。

column1: This will bring the big pain, don't stand in front of that LBX or you will not live to regret it.
column2: 这会带来很大的痛苦，不要站在那个LBX面前，否则你会后悔的。

column1: This Wolfhound variant got a large refit with Clan Grade Structure and Armor alongside RISC Tech Equipment and Production.
column2: 这款猎狼犬变种进行了大规模改装，配备了氏族级结构和装甲以及 RISC 技术设备和生产。

column1: This, Previously a Stalker-3F, Has kept its 'idea' of a Loadout. Armed with Large Chem lasers, Rockets and Thunderbolts, it will still Deal Considerable Damage. It Has also been upgraded with a Supercharger so it can keep up with other Mechs. A Single AMS system has been integrated, together with Strongly Reinforced Legs. This is one Hell of a Stalker, if i may say so myself.
column2: 这个以前是 Stalker-3F，保留了装载的“想法”。配备大型化学激光器、火箭和雷电，它仍然会造成相当大的伤害。它还升级了超级充电器，因此它可以跟上其他机甲。单个 AMS 系统已与强力加固支腿集成在一起。如果我可以自己这么说的话，这就是跟踪者的地狱。

column1: Those Fire and Forget missiles are pretty nasty, boss. I wouldn't want to be in a light mech that catches this thing's attention.
column2: 那些“发射后不管”导弹非常讨厌，老大。我不想成为引起这个东西注意的轻型机甲。

column1: Those Pwwkas that saw combat action did so in combination with other Manei Domini units, fighting primarily against forces from the Principality of Regulus and the Duchy of Oriente, although there are rumors of some Pwwka seeing action against allied coalition forces.
column2: 那些参加战斗行动的普瓦卡人与其他马内多米尼部队联合作战，主要对抗雷古勒斯公国和东方公国的部队，尽管有传言称一些普瓦卡人参加了针对盟军联军的行动。

column1: Those Quicsell Heavy PPCs are an odd beasty. Yes, they can do AC20 damage at long range. ONLY at long range though. Any closer, and they bleed damage fast. Something about the destabilization of the PPC bolt adding to the damage? I can't follow the technical specs, but I can tell you that this mech will be useless if the enemy gets into close range.
column2: 那些 Quicsell 重型 PPC 是一种奇怪的野兽。是的，它们可以在远距离造成 AC20 伤害。但仅限于远距离。如果再靠近，它们就会快速流血。 PPC 螺栓的不稳定会增加损坏吗？我无法理解技术规格，但我可以告诉你，如果敌人进入近距离，这个机甲将毫无用处。

column1: Those who get too close to this baby, will soon learn how much pain it can deliver with those SRMs.
column2: 那些离这个婴儿太近的人很快就会知道这些 SRM 会给婴儿带来多大的痛苦。

column1: Those Word of Blake engineers usually know what they are doing, which you can see in this model too. That's a lot of weaponry and they still managed to make the 'Mech a bit more durable by adding more armor and using a Light engine instead of that XL.
column2: 那些布莱克工程师通常知道他们在做什么，您也可以在这个模型中看到。这是很多武器，他们仍然设法通过添加更多装甲并使用轻型引擎而不是 XL 来使“机甲”更加耐用。

column1: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient design. A pair of arm mounted Gauss Rifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield.
column2: 虽然外观与森林狼极为相似，这款战斗机甲却是全新而强大的创造。疯猫 MK II 携带十三吨铁纤维装甲，是极为坚固的设计。臂载的双高斯步枪配以躯干搭载的 LRM 挂架，使其能完全掌控战场。

column1: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. This variant removes the Gauss Rifles and Jump Jets and replaces them with a HAG/30 in each arm. The side torsos each mount an LRM-10 and a pair of ER Medium Lasers. A Light Active Probe is mounted in the head, and the remaining tonnage is given over to more armor protection.
column2: 虽然外观与森林狼极为相似，但这款 BattleMech 是一款全新且强大的创造物。此变体移除了高斯步枪和跳跃喷气机，并用每个手臂中的 HAG/30 代替它们。侧面躯干各安装一个 LRM-10 和一对 ER 中型激光器。头部安装有轻型主动探头，剩余吨位用于更多装甲保护。

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded armor protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this armor is still too light to allow the 'Mech to operate in a stand up fight.
column2: 尽管按照圣战时代的标准，毒刺 IIC 的地面速度相对较低，但它仍然足够快，可以充当骚扰单位和侦察平台。 180 米的跳跃能力也很有用，可以让飞行员快速脱离狭窄的地形。升级后的装甲保护也受到那些使用旧毒刺的战士的重视，但这种装甲仍然太轻，无法让“机甲”在站立战斗中操作。

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded armor protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this armor is still too light to allow the 'Mech to operate in a stand up fight. column1: To call it the deadliest Locust ever built is probably an exaggeration. But all that custom equipment does make it quite impressive and will surprise most that meet it on the 'field.
column2: 将其称为有史以来最致命的蝗虫可能有些夸张。但所有这些定制设备确实让它令人印象深刻，并且会让大多数在“现场”遇到它的人感到惊讶。

column1: To protect itself from most other light 'Mechs, vehicles, and infantry the Red Shift carries two Tronel XII Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: 为了保护自己免受大多数其他轻型机甲、车辆和步兵的攻击，红移携带了两个 Tronel XII 中脉冲激光器。

column1: To sum this one up: 'too specialized'. Yes, it's good if you're fighting a swarm of VTOls, but anything short of that an you're bringing the wrong loadout to the fight. Oh, and watch those 'Double Autocannons'. They may put out a lot of bullets, but they'll break rather than jam.
column2: 总结一下这一点：“太专业了”。是的，如果你要与一大群垂直起降飞机作战，那是件好事，但如果做不到这一点，你就会在战斗中带来错误的装备。哦，看看那些“双自动炮”。他们可能会射出很多子弹，但它们会破裂而不是卡住。

column1: Too lightly armored for my taste, but at least it has a big gun, right? The main issue being, it's only really useful in close range combat, and it's got the standard XL engine vulnerability combined with weak armor. I wouldn't take this into the field if I were you.
column2: 装甲太轻了，不符合我的口味，但至少它有一把大枪，对吧？主要问题是，它只在近距离战斗中真正有用，并且具有标准的 XL 引擎漏洞和薄弱的装甲。如果我是你，我不会把这个带入这个领域。

column1: Too slow for a melee mech, if you ask me. Mostly the fault of that hardwired internal combustion engine. At least it deals with most overheating problems without issue. Good 'baby's first melee mech' for the rookies, since it's very survivable, but don't expect to spend much time in the thick of things.
column2: 如果你问我的话，对于近战机甲来说太慢了。主要是硬连线内燃机的故障。至少它可以毫无问题地处理大多数过热问题。对于新手来说，这是一个很好的“宝宝的第一个近战机甲”，因为它的生存能力很强，但不要指望在最激烈的情况下花费太多时间。

column1: Triple Mixed Tech, Questionable at Best. This Primitive Helepolis was Picked up by a well Respected Mechwarrior Outfit, upgraded it with IS Gear to be Functional Atleast. Swapped Hands and then installed Clan Gear in its Interior, as a Test bed so to Speak. There are so many different Doohickeys just to have everything work together, im Amazed it doesnt Short circuit itself.
